tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// rje btsun dam pa rgya gar nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī rak+ta bā gi sā dha ni/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dmar po'i gsung gi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab 'phel bar 'dod pa yis// dang por rjes gnang thob nas ni// skar ma rgyal la bsgrub par bya// gcig dang brgyad dang bco lnga la// sgrub na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/

dkar po /spang rgyan gla ba mtshal dkar gsum// yung ba tsan+dan a ka ru// spang spos dbang lag shu dag gsum/ dkar po/ /gser mdog rgya skyegs shing mngar gsum// dpa' bo bcu gnyis bsdu byas la// zhib par btags la sbrang rtsi dang*// ba dmar 'o mas ril bu ni// brgya dang rtsa brgyad byas nas kyang*// steng dang 'og tu hrīḥdang dhīḥ /bri ba'i snag tsha rgya skyegs dang*// gur gum gi'u waṃ bsres la bri// rin chen snod du blugs par bya// pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad dbus// gong gi ril bu bzhag nas ni// dmar ser dar gyi gur yang dbub// shar du kha bltas stong nyid bsgom// stong pa'i ngang las seng ge'i gdan// de steng pad+ma zla ba'i gdan// yi ge dhīḥdamar tsheg drag can// 'od zer dmar po 'phro bar bsam// de las bdag nyid 'jam dpal ni// sku mdog dmar po rgyan dang ldan// 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba can// ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bsgreng*// rtse mo rin chen nor bus brgyan// ral gri pusti 'dzin mdzad pa// de ltar bdag nyid bsgoms nas ni// thugs kar bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ni// dmar po rtsibs bzhi bsam par bya// de steng ral gri sor bzhi pa// changs zung zla steng dhī dmar la// rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam// de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis// ye shes sems dpa' dgug la bstim// mdun du hrīḥlas dbyangs can ma// sku mdog nam mkha'i mdog can ni// khro 'dzum 'bar ba brjid pa'i zhal// rin chen rgyan dang do shal mdzes// dbu skra mthon mthing thor tshugs can// ral gri pusti phyag na bsnams// thugs kar pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// ral gri sor bzhi snying pos bskor// 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs bstim// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// de yi 'khor du bskor bar bsam// de ltar bsams nas dang po ni// bdag gi thugs ka'i ral gri dang*// sa bon sngags dang bcas pa las// 'od zer dmar por 'phros pa yis// bdag gi sna bug g.yas nas byung*// dbyangs can ma yi g.yon du zhugs// thugs ka'i sngags dang hrīḥl thim// thugs ka'i gnas nas tshur la byung*// bdag gi thugs kar zhugs pa las// ā li kā li'i sngags su gyur// khong pa'i nang dang ba spu'i gseb// dpag tu med pas khengs par bsam// bar gyi sngags kyi phreng ba las// 'od zer dpag tu med par 'phros// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// dus gsum bla ma yi dam dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo la sogs pa'i// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus// bdag dang lha mo'i spyi bor thim// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// blo yi mun pa bsal bar bsam// yang gcig spros pa'i byin rlabs kyis// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// dge bshes rnams kyi nus mthu dang*// mtha' yi nor bu'i 'od zer dang*// rtsi shing nags tshal bcud rnams bsdus// bdag dang lha mo'i spyi bor bstim// lus po ye shes bdud rtsis gang*// de ltar shes rab 'phel bar bsam// bzlas pa byed pa'i dus nyid du// mdun gyi ril bu la dmigs shing*// sngags 'di rgyun du bzla bar bya// oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me dī paṃ mañju shrī mum̐ hrīḥpra dz+nyā war+dha ni hrīḥdhīḥswā hā/

sngags ni phreng ba nyi shu gcig /brgya yis mi brjed gzungs thob 'gyur// stong gis sgra skad kun la mkhas// khri phrag gcig ni bzlas gyur na// nyi ma re la sh+lo ka /lnga stong re re zin 'gyur zhing*// mngon par shes pa 'char ba dang*// gzhan gyi sems ni shes pa dang*// yi ge'i rigs ni thams cad kyang*// thogs pa med par shes par 'gyur// sgra dang bstan bcos thams cad kyang*// bka' bzhin rtsom par nus pa yin// phyis ni sa yi dbang phyug thob// de nas mdun gyi sangs rgyas dang*// dbyangs can ma dang bcas pa rnams// 'od du zhu nas ril bur thim// ril bu rgyal chen bzhir mthong na// shes rab 'jam dpal rdo rje dang*// sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur// ril bu dbyangs can mar mthong na// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur// ril bu nyi zlar mthong gyur na// sngon gyi skye ba dran par 'gyur// ril bu 'od du mthong gyur na/ legs sbyar/ zur chag 'dres ma/ sha za'i skad bzhi /sgra bzhi dag la mkhas par 'gyur// 'od dang du ba rnga sgra dang*// dung 'bud nyi zla shar ba dang*// me tog 'dzugs dang zhing rmo dang*// snag tsha 'thung dang nyams dga' dang*// yi ge 'dri klog mthong ba dang*// mngon par shes pa 'char ba rnams// shes rab 'phel ba'i rtags su 'dod// rdzun dang sha chang sgog btsong dang*// sngo ngad la sogs spang bar bya// 'khon dang zhe sdang drag po dang*// sems la gnod pa'i las rnams spang*// rang la bdog pa thams cad kyis// 'jam dpal rdo rje mchod bya zhing*// rtag tu lha la gsol ba gdab// sems can rnams la snying rje bsgom// srid par 'ching ba'i las rnams spang*// gal te las 'phro yod gyur na// nyi ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur// nyi ma gsum du bsgrub pas na// las 'phro med kyang 'grub par 'gyur// grub pa'i rtags rnams ma byung na// bdag nyid dbyangs can ma ru bsgom// mdun du 'jam dpal bsgom par bya// mo 'khor steng la pho 'khor 'og

/ril bu gu gul dud pas bdug /des ni ye shes myur du 'grub// sgrub pa thon pa'i nangs par nas// nangs ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la// lto stong dag gi dus nyid du// ril bu re re gyur mid bya// shes rab 'phel zhing bcud len 'gyur// ril bu gzhan rnams ma lus par// 'khor lo gnyis ka'i bar du gtums// rdza yi ga'u'i nang du gzhug /mchod pa'i gral du bzhag par bya// gzhan gyi rtsod pa zlog pa na// rang nyid 'jam dpal bsgom pa yi// dpral bar dhīḥni dmar po bsam// dhīḥlas 'od dmar 'phros nas ni// kho yi shes rab bkug byas te// srin lag rtse yis blangs nas kyang*// rang gi dpral ba'i dhīḥl bstim// oṃ hrīḥdhīḥche ge mo ha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ /brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzlas nas ni// rig pa seng ge lta bur bsgrim// rtsod pa kun las rgyal bar 'gyur// seng ge'i sgra yis wa rnams skrag byed bzhin// nyon mongs dug rnams gcod pa'i shes rab mchog /bdag gis 'phags pa 'jam dpal la zhus pas// 'gro rnams shes rab gru yis sgrol bar shog /'jam dpal dmar po'i gsung gi sgrub thabs rje ka ma la shī las pad+ma'i ngang tshul mdzad pa rdzogs so// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa rgya gar gyi zhal nas/ gang zag shes rab brtul ba/ skye ba sngon ma la tshogs ma bsags pa yin/ de'i gnyen por shes rab spel ba'i sgrub thabs 'di mdzad do// de la rdzas spang rgyan la sogs pa'i sman rnams gzhung nas byung ba rnams sbrang rtsi dang sbyar la ba dmar gyi 'o mas ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad byas la/ de lhung bzed dam rin po che'i snod du blugs/ dar dmar ram ras la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i lte bar ral gri'i changs zung la dhīḥdamar po bri/ rtse mo la hrīḥbar du sngags bri/ 'dab ma brgyad la sngags rnams bri/ pad+ma'i phyi rol du mu khyud gsum gyi nang ma la a li/

bar pa la kā li/ phyi ma la rten 'brel snying po bris la ril bu la gdab/ de'i steng du dar dmar ser gyi gur phub/ de rang gi mdun du pad+ma ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i dbus su bzhag go /bca' thabs so// de nas stan bde ba la kha shar du bltas te 'dug la/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal ba'i don du 'jam dpal 'di bsgom snyam du sems bskyed/ de nas swa bhā was chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gsal la rang bzhin med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ rig pa dar dang bcas pa bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge sngon po gnyis bsnol ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus su yi ge dhīḥdamar po tsheg drag can bsam mo// de las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal/ slar 'dus dhīḥl thim pas/ 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar po rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bsgrengs ba/ phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri/ g.yon na ut+pa la'i steng na brgyad stong pa'i pusti bsnams pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro bar bsgoms la/ de'i thugs kar bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar ral gri sor bzhi pa gyen la bsgrengs pa'i changs zung la dhī dmar po la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim/ de nas mdun du hrīḥlas lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog sngon mo nam mkha'i mdog can ma/ khro 'dzum du 'dug pa/ rin po che'i do shal dang rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing du 'dug pa'i rtse mor nor bus brgyan pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi phyag tu ral gri dang ut+pa la'i steng du brgyad stong pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng na bzhengs pa/ sku 'gying bag dang bcas pa bsgom mo// thugs kar zla ba'i steng du ral gri sor bzhi pa'i changs zung la hrīḥsngon po la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim/

de'i rgyab tu dbyangs can ma'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor bar bsam/ de nas bdag gi thugs ka'i sngags las 'od 'phros pas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du gyur par bsam/ nang bcud kyi sems can gyi blo yi mun pa bsal nas 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka'i dhīḥlas dhīḥ'aphros/ sna bug g.yas nas byung*/ yum gyi sna bug g.yon du zhugs thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim pas/ de las grol ba'i tshul du sngags kyi phreng ba yar byung bas/ rang gi sna bug g.yon du zhugs/ de gnyis kyi bar nas shes rab kyi bung ba'i tshogs 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ nyan rang gi shes rab dang*/ so so skye bo'i sdom pa/ nus mthu rnams bsdus nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus ye shes dang ldan par gyur/ yang 'od zer las shes rab kyi bung ba'i tshogs 'phros bka' sde snod gsum gyi bcud/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i shes rab/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi nus pa/ sman gyi nus pa rnams bsdus nas rang gi ljags la thim ngag nus pa dang byin rlabs ldan par bsam/ yang 'phros pas rtsi shing nags tshal gyi bcud/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu/ rin po che'i 'od/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad kyi shes rab dang nus pa/ rgyal po dang btsun mo'i sems dang*/ de rnams bsdus la rang gi thugs kar bstim/ thugs bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang ldan par bsam/ de ltar dmigs shing*/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me dī paṃ mañju shrī mum̐ hrīḥpradz+nyā war+dhā ni hrīḥdhīḥswā hā/ zhes stong phrag gcig la sogs ji srid mi skyo ba'i bar du bzla bar bya/ de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas rtags rnams ma byung gi bar du bya'o// rtags rnams byung ba dang mdun gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dbyangs can mas gtso byas pa rnams 'od du zhu nas ril bu la thim par bsgom zhing*/

ril bu 'khor los gtums shing mgul du btags/ de nas nangs ma re la re rer bza'o// yang sgrub pa thon nas/ ril bu'i steng gi 'khor lo la 'jam dpal lnga/ dbyangs can ma bzhi/ ā li kā li'i tshogs/ rten 'brel gyi tshogs dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs grangs med pas bskor ba bsams la ye shes pa bstim/ pū dza 'bul/ bstod pa bya/ gsol ba gdab la 'od du zhu nas ril bu la thim par bsgom/ 'khor lo'i lte bar ril bu gtums la nangs ma re la re rer bza'o// phan yon ni/ brgya yis mi brjed gzungs thob 'gyur// ces pa la sogs pa'o// rtags ni rgyal chen bzhir mthong ba la sogs pa'o// rmi lam gyi rtags ni snag tsha 'thung ba la sogs pa'o// sgrub pa'i dus ni byi ba zla ba'i tshes gcig rta zla ba'i brgyad/ yos zla ba'i bco lnga'i nyin skar ma rgyal gyi nyi ma la mgo brtsam/ dam tshig ni/ rdzun sha chang sgog pa sngo dang*/ zhe sdang drag po/ grogs ngan/ mya ngan smre sngags/ pho mo 'khrigs pa rnams spang zhing*/ sems can rnams la snying rje bsgom/ nyal ba'i dus su yang*/ snang ba rim gyis bsdus nas 'jam dpal la bstim/ de yang thugs ka'i 'khor lo la/ de ral gri la/ de dhīḥl/ de thig le dmar po la bstim/ thig le de 'od du zhu nas snang ba thams cad dmar lam gyis song bar bsgoms la nyal lo// tho rangs langs pa'i dus su/ nam mkha' stong pa las dbyangs can ma dpag tu med pas/ hrīḥdhī'i sngags brjod pas des bskul nas langs la snga ma ltar bya'o// de ltar byas pas shes rab phyogs med du skye zhing*/ mthar rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// bzlas pas skyo na gtor ma btang ba ni/ rin po che'i snod du kha zas kyi rnam pa blugs la/ skad cig gis rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ kha zas kyi rnam pa dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsgoms la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun du pad+ma'i sdong po gcig gi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du lha mo dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam mo// de la ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstims nas ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥsogs kyi mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ bstod pa bya/ gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ 'jam dpal dmar po sgrub pa'i rim pa dam pa rgya gar gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// ༈ /bstod pa ni/ oṃ/ chos dbyings rnam dag pho brang nas// 'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa// zug rngu med pa 'jam pa'i dpal// sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dang*// drwa ba drwa phyed do shal dang*// rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes te// ral gri pusti 'dzin mdzad cing*// log lta'i mun pa sel mdzad pa'i// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bsgreng*// seng ge sngon po'i gdan la bzhugs// lo brgyad byis pa'i cha lugs can// zug rngu med la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes can// zug rngu ma lus sel mdzad cing*// dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang*// mtshan rnams thams cad rab rdzogs pa'i// 'jam dpal rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jam dpal mgon po thugs rje can// 'od zer brgya phrag mang po'i sku// sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab sngags pa'i// sprul pa'i sangs rgyas mang pos brgyan// 'phags pa 'jam dpal phyag 'tshal bstod// yum gyi bstod pa ni/ oṃ/ dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i rigs kyi yum// mnyam pa nyid kyi sku mdog sngon mor bzhugs// rin chen nor bu'i rgyan gyis rab mdzes pa'i// yum mchog dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// dug gsum sel mdzad rje btsun ma// bde gshegs sangs rgyas kun gyi yum// ral gri g.yas la pusti g.yon// shes rab dpal mo dngos grub stsol// dug gsum sel mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag sogs sems can ma lus pa'i// blo la mun pa bsal nas kyang*// shes rab nyi ma lta bu yi// mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol//

༈ /na mo gu ru/ shes rab 'phel bar 'dod na/ 'jam dpal gyi bskyed rim gzhung ltar bya/ rdzogs rim rgyas bsdus gnyis las rgyas pa ni/ rang 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar/ ral gri changs zung la yi ge dhīḥkha dog dmar po can las 'od 'phros pas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu nas nang bcud kyi sems can la thim/ de sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la thim/ de mdun gyi dbyangs can ma la thim/ de 'jam dpal gyi thugs kar thim/ 'jam dpal lus stod smad bsdus nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim/ de 'khor lo'i lte ba'i ral gri la thim/ de dhīḥl thim/ dhīḥ'od du zhu nas thig le dmar po zhig tu gyur par bsam/ de la sems gtad la bsgom/ de nas thig le de las thig le sngon po gcig 'phros te gnyis su gyur pa la sems gtad/ de nas thig le de gnyis dang po cung zad 'gul bar bsams la/ ngag tu hrīḥdhīḥzhes brjod/ de nas thig le gnyis char dhe'u 'phangs pa bzhin du nam mkha' la yar 'phag mar 'phag tu gyur par bsams mthar sems can gyis khyab tshad la yar 'phag mar 'phag par bsams la/ ngag tu hrīḥdhīḥzhes pa'i sngags brjod par bya'o// de nas nyal ba'i dus su thig le 'od du zhu nas snang ba thams cad dmar lam gyis song bar bsams la/ dmar lam me ba'i bde stong gi ngang la nyal bar bya'o// tho rangs dbyangs can ma'i tshogs kyis sngags brjod par bsams la/ des skul ba'i bsam pas langs la/ snga ma ltar bskyed rdzogs bsgom par bya'o// bsdus pa ni/ dbyangs can ma'i thugs ka'i hrīḥsngon po la dmigs pa gtad la/ ngag tu hrīḥdhī ma me'i sngags brjod cing ji srid mi skyo ba'i bar bzlas pa bya'o// 'jam dpal dmar po'i gsung gi rdzogs rim mo// ༈ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal blta bar 'dod pas/ gi'u wang dang ga bur gyi phye ma lag pa g.yon du blugs pa chu gtsang ma dang bsres te 'jam dpal du mos la/

rtsa sngags la/ na mo mañju shrī siṃ ha ni ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas mig la byugs na 'jam dpal gyi zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro// ༈ /na mo mañju shri ye/ shes rab 'phel ba'i thabs kyi rdzas bcu gnyis gzhung na gsal/ khyad par du dbang du sdud par 'dod na/ dge bshes la rin po che'i phye ma/ rgyal po la lcags phye/ blon po la mgron bu/ 'bangs la tsha ba gsum/ btsun mo la gi'u wang*/ skyes pa la gur gum/ mi phal pa la seng ldeng*/ sman pa la a ru ra mchu snyung*/ de rnams btang ngo*// sgrub pa thon nas ril bu rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ lam bzhi mdo'am/ mi mang po 'dus pa'i sar ba dmar ser gyi lci ba dang bsres nas bsregs pa'i du ba rlung la bskur/ yang na byin/ yang na pho brang gi sgo la brdeg go /mdog bsgyur ba ni/ shes rab 'phel bar 'dod na ser po/ dbang du sdud na dmar po bya'o// 'khor lo rgya skyegs kyis bri'o// pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba na yod pa'i ral gri changs zung la dhīḥ rtse mo la hrīḥ bar du sngags bri/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi rtse mo la hrīḥ lte ba'i phyogs su dhīḥ mtha' ma la rten 'brel snying po g.yon skor du bris la/ des ril bu'i zhal khebs bya/ yang gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa gcig gi lte ba la rang gi gsang mtshan bris/ rtsibs shar ma la tāṃ/ lhor hrīḥ nub tu dhīḥ byang du bhe bris la ril bu'i zhabs su 'ding*/ steng du dar dmar ser gyi gur phub/ ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pa sna bug g.yas nas byung*/ yum gyi sna bug g.yon du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥlas grol ba'i tshul du sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ rang gi sna bug g.yon du zhugs/ de'i bar du shes rab kyi bung ba'i tshogs 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs/ nyan rang gi shes rab/

so so skye bo'i nus pa/ rin po che'i bcud/ sman gyi nus pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi nus pa/ bka' dang bstan bcos kyi bcud/ nor bu rin po che'i 'od/ nyi zla'i 'od/ klu chen brgyad kyi nus pa/ rtsi shing nags tshal gyi bkrag dang gzi mdangs/ rgyal po dang blon po'i sems la sogs pa thams cad bkug nas 'ongs pa ril bu la bstim mo// shes rab spel ba dang dbang du bya ba'i bca' ka ting nge 'dzin gsal du so sor phye ba rdzogs so// ༈ /rgyal po dbang du bsdu bar 'dod na/ lhung bzed kyi nang du a ru ra/ sher shing*/ ma gi ta rnams sbrang rtsi dang bsdus la/ ril bu sran ma tsam brgya rtsa brgyad byas nas/ dar ser po la 'khor lo gzhung ltar bris pas bkab la/ rang 'jam dpal gzhung bzhin bskyed la/ mdun du lha mo dbyangs can ma bsgom/ de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi ral gri sor bzhi pa gcig bsam/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ dri za dang*/ mi'am ci'i bkrag mdangs gzi brjid

skyes pa'i snying ga nas nṛ'i rnam pa dang*/ bud med kyi bha ga nas s+t+rī'i rnam pas/ thams cad bkug nas ril bu la thim par bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me dī paṃ mañju shrī muṃ hrīḥpra dz+nyā bar+dhā ni shrī siṃ ha mu pa ta mañju shrī che ge mo wa shaṃ ma na ye swā hā/ sngags 'di khri tsho gcig la sogs pa bzlas la/ 'od/ du ba/ rnga sgra/ dung*/ gdugs/ me tog gi char 'bebs pa byung na 'khor los dril la mgul tu gdags so// ril bu rnams bsgrub bya'i gos sam lus la byugs pa'am ltor byin nam/ yang na rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ lam gyi bzhi mdo'am/ mi mang po 'dus pa'i sar ba dmar ser gyi lci ba dang bsres nas bsregs na rgyal srid la sogs pa'i snang ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro// blon po la sogs pa gzhan la'ang de dang 'dra ba'o// ༈ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ mu dra dbang du bya ba mdzes ma rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni/ dar dkar gyi ni gzhi ma la/ dpa' bo bcu gnyis sbyar ba'i chus// bal po'i se'u'i smyug gus bri// pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud bcas// sngags 'di dgu gnyis bri bar bya// oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me dī paṃ mañju shrī muṃ hrīḥpra dz+nyā bar+dhā ni hrīḥche ge mo wa shaṃ ma na ye swā hā/ dbang sdud sngags kyi phreng ba 'di// dgu gnyis bar du ma nor bri// mu khyud ā li'i phreng bas bskor// de ltar rgyan 'khor bris byas la// shes rab ril bu'i zhal khebs bya// bdag nyid 'jam dpal dbyangs su bsam// ril bu dbyangs can ma ru bsgom// bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas rnams// sprin phung lta bur bzhugs par bsam// thugs ka'i sngags kyi 'od zer las// lcags kyu lta bu'i bung ba 'phros// dmigs pa'i bsgrub bya 'khor dang bcas// bkug nas rang gi mdun du ni// skra grol gcer bu 'dod pas gdung*// thal mo sbyar nas 'dar bar bsam// rgyan 'khor rang gi mdzod spu dang*// dmigs bya'i bha gar bsgom par bya// mdzod spu'i 'khor lo'i 'od zer des// gsang ba'i 'khor lo bskul ba las// 'od kyi tshul du chad nas ni// rgal tshigs rin chen rta la brgyud// smin mtshams mdzod spu nas byung ste// bdag gi mdzod spu'i 'khor lor bstim// dmigs bya'i 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor// thun par zhabs su gzir bar bya// zhag bdun gyis ni nges par 'grub// mchod bstod shes pa brjod nas su// ril bu shes rab rdzas su bya// yang na bsgrub bya'i gos sam skra// lus la byugs sam khar sbyin bya// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// mi'am ci dang mi'i bu mo// thogs pa med par dbang du 'du// 'khor lo rang gi lus la sogs// gsang ste bcang na dngos grub ster// gzhan yang sman sna bcu gnyis la// gi'u wang bsres pa'i ril bu bya// 'khor lo ming spel bcas pa yis// ril bu'i steng nas dgab par bya// rang nyid 'jam dpal dbyangs bskyed pa'i// thugs ka'i dhīḥlas shes rab kyi// bung ba dmar po'i tshogs spros pas// bsgrub bya'i bkrag mdangs gzi mdangs dang*// bcud rnams bsdus nas ril bur bstim// hrīḥdhī'i sngags phreng sham bur bcas// rtags rnams ma byung bar du bzla// rtags byung nas ni bsgrub bya la// byin nam lus la byugs gyur na// rang dbang med par dbang du 'du// dbang gi las tshogs bstan pa'o//

༈ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ gzhan gyi ngag rku ba ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ sngags pa nus pa can nam/ rigs kyi gtso bo dran pa can la bya ste/ bsgrub bya'i lce steng na pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa kha thur du bstan pa zhig bsam/ snying gi dkyil du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha gyen du bstan pa zhig bsam/ de gnyis kha sbyar gyi tshul du bsam pa'i nang du/ ā li kā li thabs shes kyis gang bar bsam/ de nas rang 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od dmar po 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pas/ kho'i snying ga'i ā li kā li la bstim/ yang rang gi snying ga'i dhīḥlas shes rab kyi bung ba dmar po'i tshogs grangs med pa spros pas/ bsgrub bya'i khong par zhugs pas/ ā li kā li rnams so sor khyer nas 'ong ste rang gi lce steng du thim par bsam/ de nas kho'i snying ga'i pad+ma lce steng gi pad+ma la thim par bsam/ lce steng gi pad+ma yang 'od zer dmar pos drangs nas rang gi lce la thim par bsam/ des kho'i bran pa dang shes pa nyams nas rang la dran pa dang shes rab skye'o// spobs pa skye bar bsam/ ngag rku ba'i gdams pa'o// ༈ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ pha rol gyi shes rab 'phrog pa ni/ bsgrub bya shes rab che ba la bya ste/ bsgrub bya de'i rtsa a ba dhū ti'i mar sna sbun gu la thug pa/ yar sna smin mtshams su thug pa/ de'i nang na shes rab kyi ngo bo aḥdamar pos tham gyis gang bar bsam/ de'i smin mtshams su bug pa gru gsum pa gcig bug par bsam/ rang 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ shes rab kyi aḥrnams rim gyis drangs nas bdag gi thugs kar thim/ mthar kho'i shes rab kyi aḥrnams zad nas lus stongs sangs kyis song bar bsgom/ rang gi lus shes rab kyi as gang bar bsam zhing sngags brjod do// des shes rab phyogs med du skye'o// shes rab 'phrog pa'i man ngag go

/-i thi// ༈ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ mngon shes 'dod na lhung bzed nang du mu tig dmar po/ me tog la zer/ a ga ru nag po/ spos dkar rnams ba dmar skya'i 'o ma dang bsres te/ ril bu byas te lhung bzed nang du blugs/ dar ser pos kha bkab la/ bdag 'jam dpal du gzhung bzhin bsgom/ mdun du dbyangs can ma bsams la/ sngags 'di khri gcig la sogs pa bzla'o// oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me dī paṃ mañju shrī muṃ hrīḥpradz+nyā bar+dhā ni hrīḥdhīḥbā gī shwa ri muṃ swā hā/ zhes nyi ma gzas zin par ltor zos nas mngon par shes pa rgya chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro// mngon par shes pa sgrub pa'i man ngag bstan pa'o// ༈ /rkang mgyogs 'dod na/ rta'i mgrin pa'i sha btang*/ mig rno bar 'dod na 'ug pa dang mthing ril gyi mig 'bras btang*/ hrīḥdhīḥ'i sngags kyi sham bu la gang 'dod pa wa shaṃ ma na ye swā hā/ zhes btags la bzla'o// sgrub pa thon nas 'khor lo la 'jam dpal lnga dang*/ dbyangs can ma bzhi la sogs pa dmigs pa'i tshul dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ā li kā li rten 'brel snying po rnams zhu nas ril bu la thim par bsam mo// 'khor los ril bu gtums snod byas nas lus la bcang pa la sogs pa gong du bstan pa bzhin bya'o// gdams phran bstan pa'o// ༈ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ sman rnams kyi ni thun tshod dang*// ril bu'i dbyibs dang kha dog dang*// sgrub pa'i dus tshod bstan pa ni// shu dag spang rgyan mtshal dkar gsum// gla rtsi yung ba spang spos gsum// shing mngar rgya skyegs a ru ra// de dag zho ni phyed phyed do// dbang po lag pa gsum du 'dod// tsan+dan a ga ru nag po// de dag zho ni re re'i tshad// ba dmar 'o ma 'jam dbyangs rdzas// ra dkar 'o ma dbyangs can ma// sbrang rtsi dbang sdud rdzas su 'dod// dpa' bo bcu gnyis thun mong yin// de ltar rdzas rnams tshogs byas la// ril bu dril la dri bzang gis// hrīḥdhīḥbris la yab sngags brjod// shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhi dang*// mtshams rnams su ni rim bzhin bzhag

/'khor lo'i lte ba'i ral gri'i rgyu// tsan+dan dag gam ma rnyed na// shug pa dmar po sor bzhi la// yi ge bsnyen pa bzhin du bri// ral gri rang la kha bstan la// shar du tāṃ sogs bris pa yi// 'khor lo rtsibs bzhis gdan bya ste// steng nas 'gebs pa'i 'khor lo yi// shar sogs phyogs rnams ma nor bar// mkhas pas legs par 'gebs pa gces// sgrub pa tshar khar zhag lnga sogs// gong nas pad+ma'i mu khyud kyi// sngags las 'od zer 'phros nas ni// 'khor lo dag la bstim pa gces// maṇ+ḍal bri ba nas brtsams te// ril bu bza' ba'i bar dag tu// bca' gzhi mis ma mthong ba gces// gal te mthong zhing rtags log na// bca' gzhi bskyar la bsgrub par bya// ril bu'i tshad ni sran ma tsam// dbyibs ni zhi bar zlum leb la// dbang la zla gam dag tu bshad// rgyas par gru bzhir bya'o zhes// dam pa rnams kyi ngag las byung*// kha dog dag kyang zhi la dkar// dbang la dmar zhing rgyas la ser// shes rab gtso bor sgrub pa na// ser po bya ba man ngag yin// dbang sdud so so'i rdzas rnams ni// so so'i skabs su shes par bya// gong du bstan pa'i gza' skar rnams// sgrub pa'i dus su ma 'dzom na// zla ba yar ngo'i rgyal dang ni// khrum stod dang ni khrum smad dang*// nam gru dag ni bzang bar bshad// gza' yang phur bu lhag pa dang*// zla ba pa wa sangs rnams shis// rdzas sbyor gza' skar bstan pa'o// ༈ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ ril bu'i gdan gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i shar du sgrol ma dkar mo/ g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal/ zhabs phyed krung du bzhugs pa/ thugs kar tām̐ yig gis mtshan pa'i mtha' ma na/ na mo dhi dha dha ri ki swā hā/ zhes pas g.yas su skor bar bsam/ lhor thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thugs ka na hrīḥs mtshan pa/ hrīḥ'i mtha' ma na/

na ma ār+ya pa lo dhā ra ṇi pradz+nyā war+dhā ni swā hā/ zhes pas g.yas su bskor bar bsam/ nub tu dbyangs can ma dmar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon pad+ma/ thugs kar dhīḥs mtshan pa'i mtha' mar oṃ āḥpra dz+nyā war+dhā ni swā hā/ zhes pas g.yas su bskor bar bsam/ byang du gza' phur bu dmar po g.yas rat+na/ g.yon na shing tog bsnams pa/ thugs kar bhes mtshan pa/ bhe'i mtha' ma na/ na mo bhe sha rat+na pra dz+nyā war+dhā ni swā hā/ zhes pas g.yas su bskor bar bsam/ kun kyang phyed krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'gying bag dang bcas pa/ sems can la ma ltar brtse bas ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas sgrub pa po la ster bar bsam zhing*/ ril bu la'ang dus drug tu bskyed bstim bya'o// sgrol ma dkar ser dmar sngo bzhis kyang bar chad thams cad bsal bar bsam/ shes rab spel zhing dngos grub ster bar bsam/ thun re la'ang ting nge 'dzin rgyun ma chad par bya'o// bca' thabs dang ril bu'i gdan gyi rnam gzhag go /'jam dpal dmar po'i gsung gi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs so// ༈ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga ni/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su ril bu bzhag la/ mtha' la mchod pas bskor/ dkar gtor gcig bshams la bdag nyid 'jam dpal/ ril bu dbyangs can mar bskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' bstims la bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gtor ma phul/ bstod pa bya/ ril bu la dbyangs can ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas pa thim par bsam/ slob ma khrus byas la/ yan lag bdun pa phul nas slob dpon gyi drung du 'dug cing*/ slob dpon gyi spyi gtsug nas 'jam dpal byon nas/ slob ma'i spyi gtsug tu thim pas 'jam dpal gyi skur gyur nas/ sku'i dbang phyug thob par bsam/ zhal nas sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams dmar po byung*/

slob ma'i lce la thim pas/ gsung gi dbang phyug thob par bsam/ thugs ka nas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa byung*/ slob ma'i snying gar thim pas/ thugs kyi dbang phyug thob par bsam/ g.yon pa'i ut+pala'i steng gi pusti 'phros/ slob ma'i lte bar thim pas/ yon tan gyi dbang phyug thob par bsam/ ril bu slob ma'i khar bcug la/ slob dpon gyi spyi gtsug nas dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ mgrin pa nas dmar mo/ thugs ka nas sngon mo/ lte ba nas ser mo/ gsang gnas nas ljang gu rnams byon nas/ slob ma'i gnas lngar thim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kun gyi dbang phyug thob par bsam/ phreng ba gcig la 'jus te sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug la bzod gsol byas te/ gshegs su gsol/ maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod pa bsdu/ dge ba bsngo zhing dmigs med kyis rgyas gdab par bya/ 'jam dpal gyi rjes su gnang ba'o// 'jam dpal dmar po'i gsung gi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs so// ༈ /sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi maṇ+ḍal ni/ khru gang khru bzhi la sogs pa'i steng du/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dmar po/ 'dab ma ser po/ gong ras ljang gu/ mu khyud dkar po can bris pa'i dbus su/ mañji la sogs pa'i steng du gdan gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa bzhag de'i steng du ril bu bzhag la steng du 'khor lo gnyis kha sbyar gyis dgab/ de'i steng du dar dmar ser gyi gur phub bo// de maṇ+ḍal gyi bkod pa'o// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa logs su gsal lo/ ༈ /'jam pa'i dbyangs sgrub pa'i tshad gzhung du zhag gsum bshad kyang*/ lnga'am bcu gcig la sogs rtags pa byung gi bar du bsgrub par bya'o// sgrub dus khrus dang gtsang sbra dang yig brgya la brtson par bya'o// nyams grib 'bags btsog la 'dzem/ bzlas pa srung 'khor la 'bad pa gal che'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ 'jam dpal dmar po sgrub par 'dod pa yis/

dang po sāts+tsha dkar nag gi sbyor ba gal che ste/ de la dang po sāts+tsha nag por byed na/ nyin phyed dam nam phyed gang yang rung ba la/ sāts+tsha'i rgyu blangs la 'jim pa bya/ dur khrod kyi sol bas nag por bya/ nang khong seng du bya/ de nas gro shog gang yang rung ba la/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa bris la/ ras skud dam dar skud gang yang rung bas dkris/ de sāts+tsha'i snying por bya/ de nas zhabs bsdam/ de ni sāts+tsha nag po'i sbyor ba'o// de nas bkra shis pa'i sa la nyi ma shar dros gang yang rung ba la/ sāts+tsha'i rgyu blangs la 'bi 'bi bya ste/ sāts+tsha dkar por bya/ de'i nang du gro shog gang rung la/ dngos grub phreng ba nyi shu rtsa gcig dar ram ras sam gang yang rung bas dkris la dkar po'i nang snying bya/ de nas rab gnas bya ba ni/ dang po sems bskyed/ shū n+ya tā stong pa nyid kyi sngags brjod/ de yi ngang las rang nyid 'jam dpal dmar po'am/ yi dam gang rung du bsgom/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi sāts+tsha la phog sāts+tsha'i bum pa'i nang gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan steng na 'jam dpal dmar po gzhung bzhin bsgom/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug byas la bstim/ rten 'brel snying po brjod/ me tog gtor/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ de ni sāts+tsha dkar po la rab gnas bya thabs so// de nas nag por rab gnas bya ba ni/ nyin phyed nam phyed gang yang rung ba la/ dang po sems bskyed/ khyad par du sgrub pa byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po la/ snying rje bskyed nas tshar gcod par bya snyam du bsgom/ de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod pas/ stong pa nyid du bsgom/ de nas bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sāts+tsha nag po la phog pas/ sāts+tsha'i bum pa'i nang dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang du gyur par bsam/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na/

yi ge hūm̐ mthing ga zhig tu bsgom/ de yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje'i gshed sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i cha byad can cig bsgom/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la bstim/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ rten 'brel snying po brjod/ me tog gtor/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ de ni sāts+tsha nag po'i rab gnas bya thabs so// de nas bca' thabs bstan pa ni/ dur khrod phung shul gyi sa blangs la/ 'brub khung dkyus mtho gang zheng du sor bzhi yod pa/ kha khyer 'thug srab sor gcig yod pa byas la/ dur khrod sol bas nag por byug de khebs pa tsam gyi ro g.yas la rdo rje gya gram bri/ rgya gram la hūm̐ dang nan bri/ ri rab dkyil na/ laṃ suṃ nan bri/ de nas gro shog gang rung la gnod byed kyi ling ga lce brang gi dkyil du slebs pa la/ steng na rdo rje rgya gram zhig bri/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ nan bri/ de'i mtha' skor du mu khyud gcig bskor/ de la mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ sgrub pa po la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed gang yin pa'i lus ngag yid gsum stāṃ bha ya nan/ hūm̐ nan/ suṃ nan/ zhes g.yon skor du bri/ de nas sgrub pa byed pa'i gnas gang yin pa'i sa na maṇ+ḍal bcas pa'i 'og tu dong gru gsum khru gang ba gcig brus/ rang la zur mi bstan/ de'i nang du sngar gyi 'brub khung de bcug de'i nang du liṅga de gzhug de'i steng rdo rje rgya gram ri rab dang bcas pas mnan/ de'i steng du sāts+tsha nag po de bzhag go /de ni bca' thabs so// de la bar chad srung ba'i phyir/ sāts+tsha dkar po brgyad bya ste/ sgrub khang gi phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi dang brgyad du bzhag ting nge 'dzin ni/ dang por sems bskyed/ de nas stong nyid bsgoms pa'i ngang las/ sāts+tsha'i bum pa'i nang du 'jam dpal dmar po gzhung bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/

sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas sgrub sngags kyi mthar rak+ṣa srungs shig bya ba btags la/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o// de'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang nyid 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi 'jam dpal brgyad la phog nas/ de dag gis kyang sngags bzlas shing*/ sngags kyi 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ sgrub khang gi steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad 'jam dpal gyi gur du bsam zhing sngags bzla'o// de ni sāts+tsha dkar po'i sbyor ba srung ba'i rim pa bsgom pa'o// de nas sāts+tsha nag po'i sgo nas mnan pa bya ba ni/ dang po sems bskyed de/ sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i gnod byed la snying rje chen por bskyed/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi 'og na dpag tshad bdun tsam 'das pa'i 'og rol na/ gshin rje'i khang sgrom 'bar ba zur gsum pa'i nang na/ nad dang mtshon gyi na bun 'thibs pa/ mun khang dgu rim gyi tshul du yod pa zhig gi nang du/ sgrub pa la bar gcod byed pa'i gnod byed gang yin de/ yi ge tri ljang nag gcig las bskyed nas gan rkyal tshul du yod par bsam/ de'i lce brang thog tu phyir phyung ba'i steng du rdo rje rgya gram ri rab dang bcas pa des mnan par bsam mo// liṅga'i steng du yungs kar la sogs thun sna tshogs kyang brdal la bzhag go /'jam dpal dmar po'i sgrub thabs bar chad srung ba'i man ngag rje dam pa rgya gar nas brgyud pa*/ cho ga 'di la sngags kyi gnad dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad dang*/ bsrung 'dzin rnams legs par 'dzom na 'grub pa la the tshom med do// ༈ /dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po'i lte bar ral gri dmar po'i rtse mor hrīḥ rtsa bar dhīḥ bar du bsnyen sngags kyi sham bur che ge mo wa shaṃ ma na ye swā hā dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la hrīḥdhīḥ'i bar du gong dang mtshungs par bkod/

mu khyud nang ma la ā li mgo phyir bstan/ rgyab ma la kā li mgo nang bstan/ de'i rgyab rten 'brel snying po bri/ ral gri'i g.yas mngon par shes pa la sogs dngos grub gang 'dod pa dang*/ rā dza pho rigs thams cad myur du khug cig bri/ g.yon du longs spyod skyel ba'i mo rigs thams cad dang*/ rigs kyi ma rnams myur du khug cig bri/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su rang gi gsang mtshan bri/ rtsibs bzhi la ni snga ma ltar bya'o// ༈ /'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge yi// sgrub thabs nyin byed ces bya ba// blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed cing*// mi shes smag rum sel byed bzhugs// na mas+saṅgu ru pā dā ya/ 'dir rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge yab yum bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ ngag gis rdzun smra ba dang*/ lus kyi sha chang sogs bsten pa dang*/ sems kyis 'khon 'dzin dang zhe sdang la sogs pa spangs shing gtsang sbra dang ldan par byas la/ 'gro ba kun la bu gcig pa lta bu'i snying rje sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= zhes sgo gsum rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro ci nus byas pa'i mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas skyabs yul rnams kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yab yum gyi sgom bzlas nyams su blang par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed nas/

rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī swa ra swa twi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/

nas / nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar lan gsum gyis bdun rnam dag byas la/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa rnams sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong par bsams la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du siṃ yongs su gyur pa las seng ge sngon po mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su dhīḥyig dmar ser dang*/ de'i mdun gyi sa gzhir pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥyig mthing zhun gyi mdog lta bu de gnyis las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yi ge gnyis la thim zhing dhīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dir yi ge rnying pa rnams las yab yum tha dad du byas nas bskyed pa ni gzhung nas ril bu sgrub tshul gsungs pas 'khrul gzhi byas par snang bas gzhung don ma yin no/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge gur gum gyi mdog lta bu/ gzhon nu lang tsho la babs pa sgeg cing zhi ba'i nyams can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa dbu skra nag po thor cog gyen du bsgrengs pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bus mdzes shing lhag ma zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba dang*/ mdun gyi hrīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las dbyangs can ma sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ zhabs gnyis tsog pur phyed krung gis bzhugs shing*/ nu 'bur zung dang ldan pa/ 'dzum zhing sgeg pa'i cha lugs can/ ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba ste/

gnyis ka'i phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi bar nas ut+pal sdong bu dang bcas pa g.yas g.yon du gyes pa snyan gyi thad kar slebs pa'i steng na ral gri dang pusti 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis mdzes par bskyed pa ni bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /de nas/ yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i stod du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar ral gri sor bzhi pa'i yu ba hrīḥdang hrī yig gis mtshan pa'i mthar rtsa sngags dang*/ rtsibs la ā li dang mu khyud la kā li rnams gnas pa zhes brjod pa ni nyer sgrub kyi yan lag go /de nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim pa ni sgrub pa'i yan lag go /slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod cing de rnams la a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba sogs nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la gtso bos dbur brgyan pa'am/ gnyis ka la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes brjod pa ni sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste/

de ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad la yun ring du bsgom par bya'o// bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa bya ste/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo phyag mtshan sa bon sngags phreng rnams sngar bzhin gsal bar dmigs la/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas yab yum gyi go 'phangs la bkod de 'khor ba mtha' can du byas par bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi smon lam bskul te mkhyen brtse nus pa thams cad 'od dmar ser gyi rnam par byas nas tshur byon bdag gi snying ga'i 'khor lo phyag mtshan sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ yang de rnams las 'od zer li khri'i mdog lta bu 'phros pas bdag gi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ lha mo'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo phyag mtshan sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul te/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'od zer ā li kā li'i rnam par tshur byon nas bdag gi thugs kar thim pas sngon bsags kyi ma rig pa la sogs pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa thams cad la thogs pa med par bsam/ slar yang phar 'phro ba sogs 'khor ba'i tshul la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad la/ ngag tu/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me dī paṃ swa ra swa tī mañju shrī muṃḥhrīḥpra dz+nyā war+dhā ni hrīḥdhīḥswā hā/ mchog ster sa bon/ bdag la gsal bar dbyangs can ma 'jam dpal sa bon/ shes rab 'phel la gzhi tshugs/ bdag la gsal ba la dbyangs can ma 'jam dpal/ shes rab gsal ba la gzhi tshugs/ zhes bzla bar bya'o// bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa yin no// de ltar bzlas pas/ rmi lam du/ 'od dang*/ du ba dang*/ rnga'i sgra thos pa dang*/ me tog rgyas pa mthong ba dang*/

zhing rmo ba dang*/ me tog ser po sdud pa dang*/ nyi zla shar ba la sogs pa shes rab 'phel ba'i rtags rnams 'byung ngo*// rtags 'di rnams sgrub pa'i tshe'ang shes par bya zhing sgrub pa dngos ni gzhung na gsal ba ltar bya'o// de ltar bsnyen cing bsgrubs kyang ma 'grub na/ slar yang sems can thams cad kyi don du bsgrub pa'i bsam pas zin par byas la/ rang nyid lha mo dang de la mdun du 'jam dpal bskyed/ sngags la/ dhīḥhrīḥmañju shrī swa ra swa tī dhīḥhrīḥswā hā/ zhes pa rnams su bsgyur nas sngags kyi 'od zer dmar pos 'jam dpal gyi dam bca' bskul bas bdag la zhal ston zhing rjes su 'dzin par bsams la bzla ste spogs pa'i cho ga'o// de nas thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal nas bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi lha mo gdan dang bcas pa dang*/ bdag gi gdan yang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim zhes brjod cing dge ba byang chub chen por bsngos la thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar bya ste/ dkar gtor gtsang ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swā bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas grub na yab yum yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ ma grub na skad cig gis bskyed pa'am/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs te/ sngags ring la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum la sogs pas phul la/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī swa ra swa tī sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/

zhes tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs dang*/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi// rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs 'ongs shing*// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog ster ba'i// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ bskyed chog rgyas pa byas na ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ rang gnas nas spyan drangs pa yin na'ang*/ gshegs su gsol la/ de nas thun gyi bya ba gzhan rnams kyang bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni satwi tas mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung dang*/ bod kyi yi ge rnying pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bzhin du/ rang nyid dran gso blta ba'i ched dang*/ mched grogs dam pa rat+na rasmi'i gsung gis kyang bskul ba la brten nas/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yongs 'dzin dam pa brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi chu skyes spyi bo'i rgyan du 'dzin pa'i ban+de dpal grub kyis e waṃ chos 'khor rtser bris pa'o// i daṃ shā sa nañca sarba sa twāṃ hi to bha ban+tu// 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan par gyur cig/ ༈ /'jal dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i rjes gnang gi cho ga bklags pas don grub bzhugs so// na mas+saṅgu ru pā dā ya/ 'dir rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i sgo nas byang chub sgrub par 'dod pa'i slob ma la 'di'i rjes gnang sbyin par bya ste/ stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du ras sam shog bu la sna tshogs pad ma 'dab brgyad bris pa dgram/ de'i dbus su mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum par chu gtsang dang dri lnga sogs thun mong gi rdzas nyer lnga blugs pa'i steng du/ dung chos rdor gzungs dang bcas pa dang*/ 'dab ma rnams kyi shar du 'jam dpal gyi sku/ lhor lhung bzed dam rin po che'i snod du sman gyi ril bu/ nub tu mtshan brjod kyi glegs bam/ byang du rin po che'i snod 'bras bus bkang bar ral gri btsugs la bzhag

de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro nyer spyod gru bzhi dang shar du gtor ma bsham/ de rnams kyi steng du dar dmar ser gyi gur phub la/ de nas mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi tas rol mo byas la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gdan bsdu ba'i bar sgrub thabs ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa spro na zhabs zhum pa sogs spyi dang mthun par bskyed/ tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i nang du/ siṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa nas de'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su dhīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ smra ba'i seng ge sogs nas/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes pa zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin yab rkyang dang*/ phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi steng du/ shar du dhīḥyongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ lhor hrīḥyongs su gyur pa las dbyangs can ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phyag mtshan sogs gong dang 'dra ba/ nub tu a ā sogs nas aṃ aḥ'i bar dang*/ ka kha sogs nas k+ṣa'i bar tshar gcig brjod la/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i glegs bam dang*/

byang du dhīḥyongs su gyur pa las ral gri me 'bar ba rnams su gyur/ ces pas bskyed/ lha rnams kyi gnas gsum byin rlabs sogs gzhan rnams sgrub thabs dang 'dra ba las/ gsol gdab kyi tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la zhes pa dang*/ rgyas 'debs la chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gsum ka la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī swa ra swa tī sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs dang*/ rgyal ba kun gyi sogs kyis bstod cing*/ sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma phul te/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi phreng ba gzugs thag la 'khril te song bas bum nang gi 'jam dpal gyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la bzlas pa ci mang byas te/ mthar bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ ar+ghaṃ swā hās mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhu ba las byung ba'i chur gyur/ ces dang*/ dbyangs can ma zhu ba las byung ba'i sman gyi ril bur gyur 'di ma bsgyur kyang rung bar snang ces brjod do// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas te gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i phan yon rnams dri ma med pa'i lung las 'byung ba ltar bshad la/ slob mas slob dpon 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos su bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ thal mo sbyar la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar dmigs te/

de rnams kyi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces lan gsum dang*/ khyad par gyi gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos kyang lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ ces dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yab yum gyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ de rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ khyad par rnam smin gyi lus dang phyi rol snod bcud du snang ba thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las siṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal 'debs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas slob dpon la gus 'dud cher byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnams bsdus nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces sngags ring brjod cing dril gsil bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs te slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa// rgyu bzang dbyibs legs rin chen bum// 'jam pa'i dbyangs su byin brlabs nas// mi bskyod chu yi dbang bskur ro// oṃ hrīḥdhīḥsogs nas war+dhā ni hrīḥdhīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca mī/

'di rgyas 'debs thob pa 'dra na'ang yig rnying na mi snang*/ zhes brjod cing bum chu blud/ slar yang 'jam dpal gyi sku lag tu gtad pas sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag 'jam dpal yab yum gyi sku bsgom pa la dbang bar byas snyam du mos su gzhug de nas sman gyi ril bu slob dpon gyis khyer la/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i// dpa' bo bcu gnyis sbyar ba'i bcud// dbyangs can lha mor byin brlabs nas// rin 'byung yon tan dbang bskur ro// oṃ hrīḥdhīḥsogs gong bzhin brjod cing*/ lag pa g.yas su byin pa lte bar 'dzin du bcug la ril bu dbyangs can ma dngos su bsams la mthar mid pas yon tan thams cad rgyud la skye bar mos su gzhug de ltar na khyed kyis yon tan gyi= yon tan gyi bar chad= 'jam dpal yab yum gyi yon tan dang mnyam par byin gyis brlabs par/ yang slob dpon gyis glegs bam byin la/ rdo rje glu yi mgur blangs pa'i// rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /ā li kā lir byin brlabs nas// mtha' yas gsung gi dbang bskur ro// oṃ hrīḥdhīḥsogs brjod cing mgrin par reg tsam byas nas lag pa g.yon du gtad pa snying gar 'dzin pa'i stangs ka byed du bcug la/ slob ma'i gtso bo gcig la phreng ba'i sna gtad de dpon slob gnyis ka 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal btab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig rjes zlos byed du gzhug spro na/ slob mas me tog dang bcom ldan bdag la sogs gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'di la sogs gsum dang me tog gtor/ de nas pusti mgrin par thim pas gsung gi= ngag gi= 'jam dpal yab yum gyi gsung bzlas brjod la dbang*/

slar yang slob dpon gyis ral gri thogs te/ shes rab ral gri rnon po yis// nyon mongs mi shes ma lus gcod// ye shes sems dpar byin gyis brlabs// phyag mtshan ral gri'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ hrīḥdhīḥsogs brjod cing lag pa g.yas par byin pa 'phyar ba'i tshul dang*/ snying gar yang reg tu bcug la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo mi shes pa gcod par byed pa'i ral gri khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas thugs dang phrin las kyi= sems dang phrin las kyi nyes pa= thugs rnam par mi rtog pa bsgom pa dang*/ phrin las sgrub pa la dbang*/ de rnams la sku dang yon tan dang gsung dang thugs dang phrin las gcig tu byas pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// zhes sogs so sor brda sprad la/ rjes gtso bos maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun par byas te/ slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod bstod kyi mthar rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing*/ 'jam dpal gyi sku dang*/ glegs bam dang phyag mtshan rnams la brtan bzhugs byas te/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni theg mchog 'dzin pa puṇ+ḍā wa ra sid+dhīs bka' mchid nan gyis gnang ba lhur blangs nas/ yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bran du rloms pa'i ban+de dpal grub kyis e waṃ chos 'khor rtser bris pa'o// sarba satwa maṅga laṃ bha ban+tu/ 'di'i yig rnying kha cig las rjes gnang la slob dpon 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i lus las 'jam dpal gyi sku dang*/ dbyangs can ma rigs mi 'dra ba spro ba dang*/ sgrub thabs la bskyed rdzogs byas par snang yang blo ldan rnams kyis dpyad pa'i gnas te lung dang bstun dgos pa'i phyir ro// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub skor nyin byed snang ba bzhugs so// na mas+saṅgu ru pā dā ya/

'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i gang zag gis shes rab 'phel ba'i phyir bogs 'don du sgrub par byed pa'i tshul la/ thog mar rdzas bsags pa ni/ spang rgyan dkar po/ rtsa a ba/ mtshal dkar slad med/ yung ba/ tsan+dan dkar po/ a ga ru nag po/ spang spos/ dbang po lag pa/ shu dag dkar po/ a ru ra gser mdog rgya skyegs/ shing mngar rnams zhib par brdungs la/ gtsang sbra shin tu che bas sbrang rtsi dang ba dmar mo'i 'o ma bsres pas sbrus la/ ril bu sran ma che ba tsam cung zad leb par byas pa'i ngos gnyis la gur gum gi'u waṃ rgya skyegs rnams bsres pa'i chus dhī dang hrīḥbri'o// de nas dar ram ras la rgya skyegs kyi khu bas pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud gnyis pa bris pa'i lte bar ral gri'i yu ba la dhīḥdang rtse mo la hrīḥbris la/ ral gri'i mthar oṃ hrīḥdhīḥsogs rtsa sngags dang*/ pad 'dab la ā li gnyis gnyis te bcu drug mu khyud nang ma la kā li so gnyis/ phyi ma la ye dharma rnams mdun nas g.yon bskor du bris pa 'og tu bting ba'i dbus su ril bu rnams yi ge mgo mjug ma log par bzhag slar yang dar ram ras la rgya skyegs kyi khu bas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud gnyis dang*/ ldan pa bris pa la/ lte bar ral gri dang yig 'bru la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin pas steng nas bkab/ de rnams lhung bzed dam rin po che'i snod du bcug la/ grub na gzhi gtsang ma'i steng du rdul tshon ser pos pad 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su zhal shar du phyogs pas bzhag pa'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pas bskor ba'am mdun du bsgrigs kyang rung la/ khyad par me tog dmar po'i mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ de rnams kyi steng du dar dmar ser gyi gur phub shar phyogs su dkar gtor gtsang ma gcig kyang bsham/ rdul tshon ma 'byor na ras sogs ser po la gzhi byas pas rung ngo*// de nas rang nyid mtshams dam par bcad de stan bde ba la 'dug nas mchod pa byin rlabs rjes gnang gi yi ge nas 'byung ba bzhin byas te/

sgrub thabs ltar yab rkyang gi sgom bzlas rdzogs par byas la/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sman gyi ril bu dbyangs can mar sgrub thabs ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i rgyab tu phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs par bsams la/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ swa ra swa tī sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi la sogs pas bstod pa byas te/ bdag dang lha mo'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal btab nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa sgrub thabs bzhin las/ khyad par lha mo'i rgyud kyi sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi smon lam bskul bas mkhyen brtse'i yon tan thams cad bsdus nas ril bu lha mor bskyed pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥsogs thun re la ci 'grub bzla'o// thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba sgrub thabs ltar byas pa'i mthar/ gdan 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ dbyangs can ma 'od du zhu nas sman gyi ril bur gyur/ ces brjod la dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o// de lta bu thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs pas/ ril bu rgyal chen bzhir mthong na/ zhes sogs kyi rtags rnams ma byung gi bar du bsgrub bo// gal te ma grub na spogs chog sgrub thabs ltar byas la sgrub pa thon nas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bar du snga dro zas ma zos pa'i gong du ril bu re re zos la lhag ma rnams rdza gsar pa'i za ma tog tu blugs nas mchod gral du bzhag par bya ste/ gzhung las/ de ni shes rab gter du sba// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no// yang skabs skabs su shes rab 'grib pa'i rtags byung ba'am ma byung yang rung ril bu nas bton la sngags bzla bzhin pas zos na rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i shes rab skye bar 'gyur ro// sgrub pa 'di ni rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i dus su grub na rab yin zhing*/

ma 'dzom na'ang zla ba yar ngo'i gza' skar bzang ba gang rung la byas pas chog go /zhes pa 'di'ang ban+de dpal grub kyis yi ge rnying pa rnams kyi bcud bsdus nas e waṃ chos 'khor rtser bris pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa blo gros rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas legs skyed pa'i// thabs shes dbyer med lha mchog yab yum dang*// dam pa sangs rgyas kha che gu h+ya dang*// glan sgom yab sras rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'od zer shākya legs pa'i blo gros dang*// kīrti dh+wa dza shes rab rgyal mtshan zhabs// blo gros rgyal mtshan gzhon nu blo gros dang*// kun dga' bzang po rnams la= /grags pa rgyal mtshan legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang*// lha mchog seng ge pra dz+nyā dh+wa dza'i zhabs// skye dgu'i skyabs gcig mnyam med bka' drin can// 'dren mchog bzang po rnams la= /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol 'debs kyis// mtha' yas 'gro la brtse ba'i bsam sbyor dang*// mi zad 'khor ba'i chos kyis yid phyung ste// rnam dag lam la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// mi gtsang khams las grub pa'i phung po 'di// snang zhing brjod med lha skur rab bsgoms pas// mthong ba'i mod la sdug bsngal sel byed pa'i// rnam dag mtshan dpes kun nas mdzes par shog /ngag gis nyes par spyod pa kun spangs te// dag gsal sngags kyi bzlas pa rab brjod pas// 'gro kun ma rig gnyid las sad byed pa'i// yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan par shog /de ltar bsgom dang bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// ma yengs rtse gcig sems kyis legs spyad pas// 'ja' tshon brag ca lta bur shes byas nas// spros kun nyer zhi'i chos dbyings rtogs par shog /mdor na skye zhing skye ba kun gsal klong*// dmigs med snying rje'i rta bdun gyis drangs nas// sna tshogs thabs tshul 'od stong rab spros te// srid mtsho skams pa'i nyi mar bdag gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ni sems rgyud kyi nor bu legs par sbyangs na phan bde'i dga' ston 'byung bar rig nas de sbyong byed thabs su rje btsun dam pa brang ti ga ga na shrī bha dra la sogs pa'i yongs 'dzin dag gi zhabs rdul la bzhin du longs par re ba'i dpal ldan don grub kyis bris pa'o// ༈ /brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/ lha mchog seng ge pra dz+nyā dh+wa dza'i zhabs// zhes pa'i mtshams su/ nam mkha' dpal bzang dpal ldan don grub dang*// shes rab 'byung gnas rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ye shes bzang po sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// bstan 'dzin lhun grub nam mkha' bsam 'grub dang*// kun dga' blo gros kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dngos brgyud bla ma'i sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang mañju gho ṣas so// ༈ /'jam dbyangs smra seng gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng*// ngag gi dpal mo rje btsun dbyangs can ma// grub pa mchog brnyes dam pa sangs rgyas la// gsol ba 'debs so shes rab snang ba stsol// lung rig smra ba kha che gu h+ya'i zhabs// bstan pa'i gsal byed glan sgom yab sras dang*// mkhas btsun bzang po slob dpon 'od shāka la// gsol ba 'debs so shes rab= /skad gnyis smra ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo// thos bsam bsgom pas rgyud phyug skyi ston mchog /kun mkhyen dol bu shes rab rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba= /gnas lnga rig pa ma ti paṇa chen dang*// sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros zhabs// rgyal bas lung bstan kun dga' bzang po la// gsol ba= /gu ge pan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*// mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i dpal// rgyal ba gnyis pa lha mchog seng ge la// gsol ba= /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// rdo rje 'chang dbang sangs rgyas seng ge'i zhabs// brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la// gsol ba=

/mkhas grub gtsug rgyan dpal ldan don grub dang*// chos kyi rgyal po shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs// 'dren pa mnyam med ye shes bzang po la// gsol ba= /brtse chen dbang phyug sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs// 'jigs bral dpa' bo nam mkha' bsam 'grub la// gsol ba= /ngag dbang shes rab rin chen grags pa dang*// 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so shes rab snang ba stsol// gus pa chen pos gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i de nyid don// sgrib byed 'khrul pa'i las nyon kun sbyangs nas// mi brjed gzungs dang blo gros spobs pa stsol// srid zhi'i chos kun sor mo'i 'du byed kyis// ngo mtshar gzugs su bskrun sogs sgo gsum gyi// 'phrul las byung ba'i brgyad lhag bcu phrag gi /bzo yi rig pa 'dzin pa'i blo gros stsol// gnas lugs gso bya'i mtshan nyid legs rtogs nas// gso byed yan lag brgyad kyi zla g.yon gyis// lus can nye zho'i gdung ba kun bcil ba'i// tshe yi rig pa 'dzin pa'i blo gros= /legs par sbyar ba'i brda sprod gzhung lugs las// rjes bstan ming dang tshig gi sdeb sbyor dang*// snyan ngag mngon brjod zlos gar la sogs pa'i// brda sprod rig pa 'dzin= /gzhal bya tshad ma gsum gyi gnad gsang kun// 'jal byed tshad ma gsum gyis gsal byed pa'i// 'khrul med lung dang dngos stobs rigs pa sogs// rtog ge'i rig pa= /bye mdo sems tsam dbu ma'i grub mtha' dang*// nges gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde'i rim pa sogs// rgyal ba'i bka' dang de yi dgongs 'grel bcas// nang don rig pa= /rgya chen gzhung lugs kun la thos pa dang*// de don tshul bzhin rtogs phyir bsam pa dang*// gnad don ma 'khrul sgom pa'i rim pa rnams// nyams len rgyud la bskyed pa'i blo gros stsol// gsung rab dgongs don ji bzhin 'chang ba dang*// tshul dang tshul min 'byed phyir rtsod pa dang*// zab don bkral dang 'khrug sdeb rtsom rnams kyis// bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i blo gros stsol// zhes pa'ang dge slong kun dga' don grub kyi ngor/

shākya'i dge slong dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis 'phral du bris te gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam bzhag ngag 'don dang bcas pa rmongs pa'i bdud las rnam rgyal ye shes mchog gi nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī māṅgu ru wā gī shwa rā ya/ rgyal rnams bskyed kyang rgyal bas btul zhugs kyis// smra ba'i dpal sbyin smra ba'i seng ge dang*// 'phags mchog tshems las byung zhing 'phags pa'i tshogs// dbyangs kyis mnyes mdzad dbyangs can lha mor 'dud// ye shes ma la ya ri nas// nyer 'phos phrin las dri bsung gis// las nyon gdung ba kun bcil nas// zag med chos kun mngon gyur mdzod// chos rab 'byed pa'i blo gros dang*// mkhas pa mgu byed ngag gi dpal// mngon 'dod skye bos bde blag tu// 'grub byed gdams pa'i rnam gzhag spro// de yang slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ mthong dang ma mthong yon tan ni// kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab ste// zhes mngon sum tshad mas gzhal byar gyur pa mthong chos tshe 'di dang*/ rjes dpag dang lung gis gzhal byar gyur pa ma mthong ba tshe phyi ma phan chad kyi yon tan te bsngags 'os kyi dngos po kun gyi rtsa ba ni rnam par dpyod pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi shes rab yin pas de nyid skyed pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ thabs kyang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ dge dang sdig pa gang yin zhes// yang dag dri la brtson pa dang*// chos kyi bstan bcos byin pa yis// blo gros rgya chen thob par 'gyur// ces gsungs pas mtshon thun mong gi thabs bsam las 'das kyang*/ khyad par du gyur pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rnams nas lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la brten nas gzugs kyi sgo sgrub pa'i tshul ji snyed cig gsungs pa las/ 'dir thugs dam gyi lha bsam gyis mi khyab pas zhal bstan cing*/

grub thob mtha' dag gis gdams pa'i mdzod byin pa/ sku tshe de nyid kyis ye shes mchog brnyes shing*/ thabs dang rten 'brel la dbang 'byor pa/ mkhas pa chen po ka ma la shī la'am rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gdams ngag thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis su grags pa'i ya gyal/ byin rlabs mngon sum du 'byung ba'i ngo mtshar can 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge yab yum gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas ye shes kyi mig dang ngag gi dpal yon sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i gang zag rnams kyis 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ nges shes skyed pa lo rgyus dang 'bras bu la sbyor ba gdams pa dngos so// phyi ma la dngos grub sgrub pa'i snod du bya ba rjes gnang dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa gnyis/ phyi ma la'ang dang po lha nye bar bsnyen pa/ bar du dngos grub sgrub pa/ tha mar las sbyor gyi sgo nas rang gzhan la phan gdags pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ rgyu skar rgyal lam 'byung khams me rlung nang 'phrad sogs dge ba'i nyin gtsang zhing dben pa'i gnas su 'di nyid kyi bris sku yod na bkram pa'i thad du/ dkar gtor gcig chu gnyis nyer spyod bcas bsham/ mdun du rdor dril cha gsum gtor ma sogs sta gon bya/ sgo drung du tho brtsigs la 'grul bcad/ cha gsum spyi ltar btang ba'i rjes su yungs kar 'thor zhing gu gul gyi dud pa dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring bzla/ sa phyogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas skyabs 'gro gang mang gzhir byas pa'i thun bzung mthar gtor ma phul la rjes kyi cho ga rnams bya/ kha ton gzhan yod na tshar 'phral srod thun la 'jug nyi ma rjes ma rnams la gtor ma snga thun gyi rjes la 'bul/ thog ma'i zhag kha shas skyabs 'gro dang sgrib sbyong gi rigs gtso bo bya/

sgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don rin po che dpal ldan don grub kyi yig cha'i steng nas byas na bde mod gtso bor dpe dang lung gang 'byor gyi steng nas byas pas khyab/ rgya gzhung dang yig rnying gi skor thob phyin chad 'don bya'i lung thob ma thob kyi rtsis gdab dgos pa chung*/ bzlas dmigs skabs rgya gzhung ltar na sngon du 'od zer 'khor dmigs byas la ā li kā lir gyur pas khong pa'i nang dang ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad khengs par bsam/ slar yang sngags kyi phreng ba rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas/ rang dang lha mo'i spyi bo nas bstim/ yang 'od 'phros lung gi chos nyan bshad sgrub pa glegs bam dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ mkhas pa'i mkhyen rab dang*/ grub pa'i nus mthu/ nyi zla dang nor bu'i 'od mdangs/ rtsi shing nags tshal sogs kyi bcud rnams bsdus nas sngar bzhin bstims pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i rkyen gyis shes rab 'phel bar bsams la sngags bzla/ yang dam pa'i gsung sgros kyi yig rnying khyad par can ltar na/ lhar bskyed zin pa'i rjes su rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud kyi dri ma sbyangs te gzhal yas khang dang 'jam dpal kyi skur gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i dhīḥlas dhīḥ'aphros sna bug g.yas nas byung*/ yum gyi sna bug g.yon du zhugs thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de las grol ba'i tshul du sngags kyi phreng ba yar byung ba/ rang gi sna bug g.yon du zhugs/ de gnyis kyi bar nas shes rab kyi bung ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma sogs sngar bzhin dang 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams kyi blo dang mthu rtsal thams cad bsdus te/ spyi bo dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga rnams su thim pas lus ngag yid gsum rim pa bzhin bde ba dang nus pa dang ye shes mchog dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs par bsams la bzla/

'di gnyis kar yab yum gyi 'khor du sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor bar gsungs so// thun mtshams rnams su dad pa dang snying rje rtsal thon par bsgom zhing tshogs bsags kyi rigs dang*/ khyad par 'jam dpal gtso bor gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i maṇ+ḍal sgrub cing mchod pa'i tshul la 'bad na legs snyam ste/ gzhung las/ rang la bdog pa thams cad kyis// 'jam dpal rdo rje mchod bya zhing*// rtag tu lha la gsol ba gdab// sems can rnams la snying rje bsgom// zhes gsungs pa'i don du 'gyur bas so// rnal 'byor chen po'i rjes spyod rgyun chags su byar med na/ nyal ba'i dus su snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'od du zhu nas sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la thim/ de dbyangs can ma la/ de rang nyid 'jam dpal du gsal ba la thim/ de yang sku'i stod smad nas bsdus te thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim/ de ral gri la/ de dhīḥl thim/ de 'od du zhu nas thig le dmar po zhig tu gyur/ de yang zhu nas snang ba thams cad dmar lam gyis song bar bsams la 'dzin med kyi ngang du nyal lo// tho rangs nam mkha' nas dbyangs can ma'i tshogs kyi sgras gnyid las bslangs par bsams la lha'i skur langs te srod thun gyi mjug chog rnams 'dir byas pas rung ngo*// thun snga ma rnams kyi mthar rdzogs rim bsgom par spro na/ dhīḥyig thig le dmar por gyur pa'i bar sngar bzhin la/ de nas thig le de las thig le sngon po gcig 'phros te gnyis su gyur pa la sems gtad/ de nas thig le de gnyis cung zad 'gul bar bsams la ngag tu hrīḥdhīḥzhes brjod/ slar yang thig le gnyis gcig char du dhe'u 'phangs pa bzhin du nam mkha' la yar 'phag mar 'phag tu gyur cing mthar sems can gyis khyab tshad la de ltar byas par bsams la sngar bzhin hrīḥdang dhīḥbazla ba ni rgyas pa yin la/ bsdus pa ni/ yum gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥsngon po la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas rtsa sngags bzla ba la bzhed do// mkhas pa dag gis bskyed rdzogs kyi tha snyad la dpyad byar mdzad pa ni dpyod pa'i rigs pa nyid kyang dpyad byar 'gro ba'i nyen che ste/

lha sngags kyi khung rgyud sde 'og ma kho na nas rnyed dka' zhing*/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung du yab yum zhal sbyor gyi tsa ka li bri bar gsungs pa tsam du ma zad/ bla med kyi las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor phal cher rdor bzlas rlung sbyor dang rdzogs rim gzhan sbyar ba'ang yod cing 'ga' zhig gtsang sbra'i kun spyod kyis sgrub par gsungs pas so// de bzhin du rjes gnang gi dus gnas lnga las dbyangs can ma spro ba'ang 'gog tu mi btub ste/ lha 'di dag ni kun rdzob tu ji ltar 'dod rung*/ don la 'bras bu'i chos gzugs kyi ldog pa so sor shar ba tsam yin pas blo ngor thabs las shes rab kyi snang cha dbye ru med na thabs shes gnyis po gdod nas zung 'jug tu gnas pa'i ngo bo lhun grub 'dus ma byas su bzhed pa'i dgos pa ci/ yab yum gyi tha snyad sogs kyang blos btags pa'am tha dad spags pa'i 'dus byas tsam du 'gyur bas so// de dag ni zhar las 'ongs pa ste yig rnying gi shes byed du rlom ste blo la gang shar bkod pa'o// mdor na gtsang sbra dang ngag bcad dam po'i ngang nas thun gsum mam bzhi'i sbyor bas sngags kyi grangs 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa stan thog gcig tu bgrangs pa ni bsnyen pa'o// gnyis pa dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs ril bu'i sbyor ba ni/ sbyor ba'i skabs su sman gyi ngos 'dzin la/ spang rgyan dkar po ni/ ri mtho sar zla ba brgyad pa'i mgo tsam la skye ba me tog dkar rkyang la dmar mdangs cung zad yod pa/ ro mngar shas che ba de nyid las gzhan klungs su skye ba'i spang rgyan khra bo sogs kyis go mi chod/ gla rtsi ni sha khrag sogs kyi zol med pa'i/ rtsi ril bur 'dril ba de bzang*/

rgya gzhung gis mtshon pa'i yig cha khungs thub thams cad du gla rtsi rang snang zhing*/ de'i tshab rtsa a wa btang bar bzhed pa ni gdams pa 'di nyid bya rgyud du nan gyis bsgrub pa'i gsung cung zad 'khyogs pa'i tshul du snang mod/ deng ma nges pa'i rgyu mtshan dkyus su bkod zin to// mtshal ni shag mtshal sogs rdo mtshal gyi rigs 'di rnams yin cing*/ nang gses su dkar nag gnyis yod pa las/ kha dog dmar la dwangs shing dkar shas che ba/ 'od chung ba btul na dmar shas cher 'gro ba de mtshal dkar yin pas rdo lhad gzhan phral la btang zhing*/ kha dog smug ril bcag na 'od phram phram pa dngul rdo 'dra ba de mtshal nag yin pas mi btang ngo*// yung ba ni 'khrul so chung zhing*/ ma smin pa dang*/ rul sum sogs kyi skyon dang bral ba dgos/ tsan+dan dkar po ni ser shas che zhing dri che ba bzang*/ a ga ru nag po dngos ni/ shing mdog nag po rwa co 'dra ba mer bsregs na gu gul ltar khol zhing dri phun sum tshogs pa de yin kyang 'byor dka' bas/ ar nag dkyus ma la kha dog ji tsam gnag pa rang bzang bas de nyid btang*/ spang spos ni/ ngo bo 'khrul so chung zhing*/ dbyar yin na rtsa lo yongs rdzogs dang*/ ston yin na rtsa ba brkos la btang*/ dbang po lag pa sor mo lnga pa mchog yin la/ bzhi pa dang gsum pa'ang btang du rung*/ de man ni mi btang*/ shu dag dkar po ni/ dbyibs shu dag nag po 'dra ba dri de las chung ba/ mdog dkar ba/ gnyer ma cher med pa de dgos kyi/ deng sang 'ga' zhig gis ldum rar skye ba'i chu dag gi rtsa ba la byed pa ni rnam par 'khyams pa'o// a ru ra gser mdog sha 'thug pa/ rgya skyegs rang gi shing dang bral ba/ shing mdar ldum rar skyes pa nyid mchog tu bsngags kyang ngos zin dka' bas/ mdog ser la mngar shas che ba bzang bas shun pa phral te btang ngo*// de yang sngo sman rnams btus 'phral chu grang gis bkrus nas rlon brdung cung zad byas pas rma phabs la grib skam bya/

gzhan rnams la'ang thal ba sogs yod na bkru ba'am legs par bsal/ de rnams las dbang lag zho gsum/ tsan+dan dang a ga ru zho re re/ gzhan rnams zho phyed phyed sbyar bar gsungs shing*/ dkyus gcig la phon chen sgrub na/ snga ma'i rigs pas cha bskyed de zhib par 'thag ba dmar dang ra dkar 'o mas ril bu cung zad leb pa brgya rtsa brgyad sogs bya/ sbrang rtsis ril bur dril ba dbang sdud kyi yin pa yig rnying du gsal/ ngos gnyis su gi waṃ gur gum rgya skyegs rnams kyi khu bas hrīḥdang dhīḥre bri/ ril bu'i kha dog ser por bya zhing dbyibs gru bzhi sogs las mthun byed pa yig rnying las 'byung*/ ril bu'i gdan 'khor ni dar dmar po la gser gyis 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa mu khyud rim pa gsum can phyi rol rdo rwa me ris bskor ba/ lte bar ral gri'i changs zung la dhīḥ logs la rtsa sngags/ rtsibs bzhi la shar nas g.yas skor du dhī bi bi bi rnams dang*/ mu khyud rnams la rim pa bzhin ā li ā li rten 'brel snying po rnams g.yas skor du bri/ rgyal chen gyi tshab tu sgrol dkar sogs bskyed na rang rang gi sa bon bri/ yang na lte bar ral gri sngags bcas kyi tshab tu rang gi gsang mtshan dang*/ rtsibs bzhi la sa bon gong bzhin bri ba tsam las mu khyud sogs mi byed pa ni bsdus pa'o// zhal khebs ni dar dmar ram ras la mtshal/ rgya skyegs/ gur gum/ gi wang rnams bsres pa'i khu bas pho 'khor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ mo 'khor pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gnyis ka'i lte bar ral gri changs zung la dhīḥrtse mor hrīḥ mthar rtsa sngags kyi sham bur rang gi gsang mtshan nam ming gi mthar shes rab 'phel bar gyur cig ces dang*/ pho 'khor gyi rtsibs rnams la g.yas skor du ā li bcu drug yig 'bru gnyis gnyis dang*/ mo 'khor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la g.yon skor du kā li bri/ de yang sde pa lnga tshan lnga dang*/

mthar gnas bzhi/ dro ba bzhi rnams so sor bcad pa dang*/ 'dab ma gcig la k+ṣa bris pas 'thus sam snyam/ yang na gzhan 'dra ba las gnyis ka'i phyi rol tu mu khyud sum rim mam gnyis rim byas nas/ lte ba'i ral gri la oṃ dang swā hā med pa'i sngags/ pho 'khor gyi ral gri'i g.yas su oṃ dang g.yon du swā hā/ mo 'khor la bzlog nas bri/ rtsibs dang 'dab ma'i rtse la dhīḥ rtsa bar hrīḥ mu khyud la ā li kā li tsam mam rten 'brel snying po bri/ gang ltar yang 'khor lo gnyis ka'i dbu phyogs gcig tu yong ba bya/ de dag ni 'khor lo kha sbyor bya ba rgya gzhung nas zur tsam 'byung ba dang*/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung nas kyang ril bu'i steng du yab yum zhal sbyor gyi tsaka li 'god par bshad pa gnyis gnad gcig par bsams nas yig rnying rnams dang lha 'di'i dngos grub brnyes pa rig 'dzin karma gu ru'i gsung la gtugs nas bkod pa yin la/ dam pas mdzad par grags pa'i gzhung tshig lhug ma sogs su 'khor lo gcig las med cing rjes kyi 'khor lo bskyed bstim sogs la'ang tshul mi 'dra ba bag tsam yod pas des kyang 'thus par mngon no// gzhan yang rnam 'joms sogs bskyed bzlas byas pa'i bum pa dang mchod pa sogs tshags su tshud pa dang*/ sngar gyi sgrub khang de nyid du mtshams dam par bcad/ stegs bu ji ltar rigs par rdul tshon nam chu tshon gyis pad+ma ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i dbus su lhung bzed dam rin po che'i snod gtsang zhing yangs par gdan 'khor zhal shar du bstan pa'i steng du ril bu rnams mgo mjug ma log par bkod/ zhal khebs kyi 'khor lo kha sbyar te mo 'khor 'og dang pho 'khor steng du 'ong ba'i tshul gyis dgab/ de'i steng du dar dmar ser gyi gur phub/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang gtor ma ci 'byor pa bsham/ sbyong ba'i yo byad rnams dang*/ me long khrus ras sogs 'du byas la/

rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas ril bu 'khor lo bcas la sbyong ba gsum dang khrus gsol rgyas par bya/ dngos gzhi la/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro nas zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang sogs nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa yan chad tsam dang*/ mdun gyi ril bu gdan 'khor bcas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gdan gyi 'khor lo bris pa ji lta ba'i dbus su hrīḥlas dbyangs can ma sogs nas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis mdzes pa/ rtsibs bzhi la rang rang gi sa bon las shar du yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa/ lhor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu mig mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du rnam thos sras ser po rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang lha'i gos dang ya lad mnabs pa/ zhi zhing brjid pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs nas dbyangs can 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam par sogs 'dra/ oṃ swa ra swa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dbur brgyan/ de dag gi rgyab tu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad mgron thabs kyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ rgya gzhung sogs su mdun gyi lha 'di dag dam ye bsre ba tsam las mi 'byung yang phyi ma 'gas yan lag bzhi rdzogs mdzad 'dug par 'gal ba cher med snyam/ bskyed gzhi'i ril bu re re nas lhar gsal 'debs par mi mngon zhing*/ gdan 'khor gyi sa bon rnams kyang mtshon byed tsam las lhar bskyed rgyu min pa 'dra bas/ ril bu las gtso bo'i zhar la 'khor rnams bskyed pa las 'os med do// yig cha 'ga' zhig tu 'khor gyi bskyed chog ma bris pa ni/
