rtags kyi skabs su ril bu rgyal chen bzhir mthong na zhes dang*/ ril bu dbyangs can mar mthong na zhes sogs gtso 'khor gang rung du mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan dril na ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs mi 'dod pa'i rtags so// yang rgya gzhung gis ma zin kyang yig rnying khungs ldan rnams su rgyal chen bzhi'i tshab tu lha gzhan gsungs pa ltar mos na rtsibs bzhi la/ rang rang gi sa bon las shar du sgrol ma dkar mo g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal bsnams pa/ thugs kar tām̐ yig gi mthar/ na mo dhi dha dhā ri ki swā hā/ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ lhor thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thugs kar hrīḥyig gi mthar/ na ma ār+ya pa lo dhā ra ṇi pra dz+nyā wad+dhā ni swā hā/ zhes pa/ nub tu dbyangs can ma dmar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon pad+ma bsnams pa/ thugs kar dhīḥyig gi mthar/ oṃ āḥpra dz+nyā war+dhā ni swā hā/ zhes pas/ byang du gza' phur bu dmar po g.yas rin po che/ g.yon na shing thog bsnams pa/ thugs kar bhe yig gi mthar/ na mo bhe sha rat+na pra dz+nyā war+dhā ni swā hā/ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ kun kyang phyed krung gis bzhugs shing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'gying bag dang bcas shing*/ sems can la ma ltar brtse bas ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas sgrub pa po la ster ba'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs dang*/ gtso mo'i thugs ka'i stod du bh+rūm̐ sogs nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo dang*/ dbyangs can/ phur bu la 'jam dbyangs/ sgrol dkar dang*/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ rgyas gdab 'di ltar thob bam snyam ste da rung yig rnying gzhan rnyed na slar dpyad dgos/ de dag gi rgyab tu sogs nas bzhugs pa dang*/

phyi rol nas sgrol ma dkar ser dmar sngo bzhis bar chad sel ba dang*/ shes rab spel zhing dngos grub ster ba'i las mdzad par bsam/ lugs gnyis po gang ltar yang mchod pa sngar byin gyis brlabs zin pas bdag mdun thun mong du/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī swa ra swa tī sa pa ri wa ra zhes re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis dbul/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs su/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa bsnyen pa dang 'dra ba las 'khor rnams kyi rgyud skul bar bsam pa dang*/ dngos grub tshur bsdus pa rnams ril bu lhar bskyed pa dang*/ tsakra kha sbyar la bstim pa gtso bor bya ba ni khyad par ro/ yig cha phyi ma rnams su yab rkyang la bzlas pa sngar byas nas 'dir 'khor dmigs gtsor 'don mi byed pa dang*/ bsnyen sgrub gnyis kar snod bcud sbyang bsgyur ji skad bshad pa bzhin mi byed pa ni/ spyir man ngag bdag po'i dgongs pa las byol ba dang*/ khyad par rgyud sde 'og mar snang ba lha sogs su lta bar ma gsungs pa'i grub mtha' bskyangs ches pa'i rjes so/ /thun gyi mthar mchod bstod sngar bzhin dang*/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas bdag mdun thun mong du dbul/ slar yang mchod bstod bsdus pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba rnams bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin bya/ gtor ma gzhan yod na'ang chos skyong dang gzhi bdag spyan drangs te a kā ro'i sngags kyis phul la bar chad sel ba'i phrin las bcol/ mdun bskyed kyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mtha' nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu ste gtso 'khor lnga la thim/ de dag kyang ril bu'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ rang gi gdan bsdu ba dang*/ gnas gsum bsrung ba bsngo smon shis brjod bcas bya/ de lta bu thun gsum mam bzhi re'i khongs su bzlas pa ci 'gror 'bad pas zhag bdun la sogs pa nas/ ji skad bshad pa'i rtags rnams dngos sam rmi lam du nges par 'byung la/

ma byung na spogs pa'i cho ga ni/ ril bu gu gul gyis bdug zhal khebs kyi mo 'khor steng du 'ong bar byas la/ rang nyid dbyangs can ma dang*/ mdun gyi ril bu 'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas su bskyed la/ dbyangs can gyis bskul ba'i 'khor dmigs sogs kyi ngang nas sngags bzla ba rtags ma byung gi bar du bya/ 'di'i sngags kyi sa bon bzlog pa dhīḥhrīḥzhes pa dang mañju shrī dang swa ra swa tī dang bzlog pa yig cha phyi ma zhig tu snang mod dkyus ma 'di tsam gyis don 'grub bam snyam spyir bsnyen sgrub gang gi skabs su'ang swa ra swa tī med pa mang bas mi dgos pa yin nam snyam/ rtags byung ba dang bogs 'don du dhīḥbasnyen bya bar 'dod na/ rang sngar bzhin 'jam dbyangs su bskyed pa'i thugs ka'i nang du dhīḥdamar po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba'i rtse mo lcags kyu lta bus phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang*/ dbyangs gsal la sogs yi ge thams cad kyi nus pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi sngags pa dang*/ gtso bo dran pa can thams cad kyi blo gros dang*/ nyi zla nor bu/ snang gsal/ rtsi bcud thams cad bkug nas dhīḥl bstim/ dhīḥlas 'od 'phros/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsams la dhīḥmang du bzla/ dhīḥde ches cher 'phel/ mgrin par zhugs/ dhīḥdamar pos lus kyi nang khengs/ 'od zer me lce lta bus sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par bsams la dhīḥbazhi 'bum la sogs pa bzla'o// 'di ni bsnyen pa rkyang pa'i skabs su'ang grub na legs so// rjes kyi bya ba ni/ sgrub pa thon ma thag pho 'khor la 'jam dbyangs sngo ser dmar ljang dkar po ste rigs lnga dang*/ mo 'khor dbyangs can ma rigs lngar bskyed/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya/ mchod bstod/ spyan dbye/ brtan bzhugs rnams rab gnas spyi ltar dang*/ lha rnams zhu ba las bris pa'i 'khor lo'i rnam pa ji lta bar bsams la/

rtsa sngags dbyangs gsal/ rten 'brel snying po rnams brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas mchod bstod shis brjod bcas byas la/ zangs kyi ga'ur bcug nas lus la bcang ngo*// de nas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du nangs re bzhin lto stong la sngags bzla bzhin pas/ ril bu lnga lnga'am re re gyur mid bya zhing*/ lhag ma rnams gdan 'khor dang*/ dar dmar ser gyis gtum nas za ma tog la sogs par bcug ste mchod pa'i gral du bzhugs su gsol/ shes rab 'grib pa'i rtags byung ba'am/ ma yin kyang skabs skabs su sngar bzhin gus pas bsten na shes rab 'phel zhing bcud len du'ang 'gyur ro// bsnyen sgrub skabs kyi gegs sel ni dgos pa shar na gud du shes par bya zhing*/ dbang gi ril bu sgrub tshul kyang yig rnying rnams bsdebs pas rtogs par nus so// de dag ni lha nye bar bsnyen pa'i dgos don nam mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu yongs su smin par byed pa sgrub pa'i rim pa'o// //gsum pa las la sbyar ba la/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi sgo nas blo gros gtso bor spel ba dang*/ 'khor lo dang bsam gtan sogs kyis las phran tshegs gzhan sgrub pa'o// sbyin sreg la'ang bsnyen sgrub rim can du byas pa'i bogs 'byin dang*/ bsnyen pa rkyang pa'i kha skong ngam grub 'bras 'byin pa'i tshul lo// gnyis po gang ltar yang chos gsum gyis rtogs par bya ste/ sbyor ba'i chos ni sgrub pa'i gnas de nyid du sa stegs ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa la thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab pa'i dbus nas khru phyed kyis zlum por bskor ba thab nang dang*/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi pa gsum bskor ba'i dang po la pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug gnyis pa la rdo rje rtse gsum pa bcu drug gsum pa la me ri g.yas skor du bri/ thab kyi nang cha gsum du bgos pa'i sum cha 'khor lo'i lte ba dang*/ sum gnyis la rtsibs bzhi mu khyud dang bcas pa bri zhing*/

me ri'i phyi ru thab stegs gru bzhi pa'i grwa rnams su zla phyed rdo rje rtse nang bstan bri/ de'i phyi rol tu'ang stegs bu'i dpangs kyi tshad mtshon pa'i cha ga sor bzhi pa bya/ lte bar 'jam dpal yab yum dang*/ rtsibs bzhir sgrub pa'i dus su 'khor gang bskyed kyi phyag mtshan nam sa bon bri/ gzhi tshon thams cad ser po dang bcad dang mtshan ma li khris bya/ kha khyer ram me ri'i steng nas bud shing brtsigs pa'i nang gi 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor ting lo bzhag thab kyi shar 'jig rten pa'i byang du bstan pa'i nub tu rang gi stan kha dog ser po'i steng du sa 'ja' li lta bu bzhag

thab dang sgrub pa po gnyis ka phyogs gcig tu lta ba gzhung phal mo che'i dgongs pa yin pas shin tu legs/ de'i tshe rdzas sogs mdun nas stob pa'i dmigs pa bya gsungs/ 'ga' zhig tu rang nyid las bzhi dang mthun pa'i phyogs su lta zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi zhal rang la bstan pa'ang gsungs pas ci bder bya/ thab kyi mdun ngos su maṇ+ḍal byas pa'i steng ngam ma bde na rang gi g.yas su stegs ser por bsgyur ba'i steng du snod so sor/ dug rigs ma yin pa'i me tog ser zhing dri zhim pa/ a ru ra/ bdug spos/ mar me ste ting lo chung ngu brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ bdun tshan gnyis sogs gang dgos/ byugs spos te ga bur sogs dri lnga'i phye ma/ bshos gtsang ste lha bshos ting lo dang grangs mnyam pa'am zas mchog spyi ltar la khur ba dang*/ shing tog sogs sbags pa/ ba dmar ser gyi mar khu/ ku sha'i myu gu/ mngar gsum/ dkar gsum rnams rim pa bzhin du bsham/ bsreg rdzas rgyas par spro na/ 'di rnams kyi gong du yam shing shug pa sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing ser zhing*/ dri zhim pa la tshad khru gang pa grangs ji tsam dgos pa dang*/ mar khu/ 'og tu til sogs spyi ltar bshams kyang legs/ rang gi g.yon ngos su gtor ma gnyis chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ mdun du me yol/ rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba/ bsang chu/ ku sha'i 'thor yab/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad sogs sta gon bya/ dngos gzhi'i chos ni/ snga dro'i dus su rang nyid khrus bya/ gos rgyan ser pos brgyan nas sngar bshad pa'i stan la bzang po'i 'dug stangs zhes pa khyel 'dug gis bsdad de bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas pa tshul bzhin du bya/ dpal 'bar dge 'dun gyi rung khang ngam rgyal po'i khyim nas blangs pa'i mes sbar la/ thab la g.yas su bskor zhing rtsa sngags lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes pas thab nang gi ting lo sbar/

sngags de nyid dang mar dgang blugs gsum bud shing la khyab par bran cing rtsa skam po dang bcas te me gso/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig gis bsang chu byin gyis brlabs nas/ ku shas thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon sogs nas rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod rdzas rnams dang*/ 'bru gsum mam las sngags kyis bsregs rdzas byin gyis brlab/ bsreg rdzas rgyas pa yod na sngags rgyas sbyang bkru byin rlabs bya ba gzhan dang 'dra/ rdzas sngags so so'i spel tshig dang bcas pa dang*/ dgang blugs 'dzin tshul sogs khyad chos phra mo rnams rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gzhan nas kyang rtogs par 'gyur mod/ kho bos byas pa'i sgrol dkar gyi yig skor nas blangs na shin tu bde bar snang ngo*// rdzas spyi ltar spros tshe 'di'i khyad par gyi rdzas kyi gras nas mar khu yam shing gi rjes dang*/ zas mchog dang ku sha so so'i gnas su spo ba las nyis bldabs lta bu mi dgos snyam du sems so// thab khung bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po khru gang pa/ zabs su khru phyed pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ kha sgyer phyir gyed pa dang*/ gyen du bslangs pa dang*/ bags kyis gzhol ba ste rim pa gsum la pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang*/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang*/ me ris bskor ba/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba las me 'bar ba/ phyi rol tu stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/

me 'bar ba'i dbus su pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las me lha sku mdog ser po ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas dbyu gu dang g.yon gan+dhe 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drang*/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul bas thab kyi shar lhor bzhugs pa la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ bcug pas chu gnyis phul la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ā na la mahā bhū ta dz+wa la ya sarba bhasmī ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭā na hūm̐ phaṭa dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas dam la bzhag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bskyed pa la bstim/ slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs la/ gsol ba gdab/ dbang bskur ba rnams bdag bskyed ltar las chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams te/

oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes brjod de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis rin chen khu tshur gyis bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang*/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi kha la'ang ram̐/ zhal gyi ram̐ las 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba dgang blugs kyi ram̐ la zug pas mar khu drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī byā dī byā bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bah+nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la dbul/ de lta bu lan gsum bya ba ni byon skyems so// skabs 'dir me pra brtags te ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu phyogs kun tu 'thor ro// de nas me tog ser po la sogs pa'i khyad par gyi rdzas bcu po me lha la zur du bshams pa yod na de nyid/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pas bdun nam nyer gcig re 'bul/ med na rdzas so so'i phud logs su phris pa'i bar phud nas 'bul bar mdzad mod snga ma legs so// gang ltar yang sde tshan re re rdzogs pa'i mthar/ bdag gi blo dang*/ ye shes dang*/ ngag gi dpal yon gtso bor gyur pa'i dge legs yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes sbyar/ rdzas gzhan yod na go rim gong du smos pa ltar la so so'i spel tshig gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram 'di nyid kyis kyang 'thus so// slar yang mchod bstod gong ltar dang*/ mar dgang blugs gang thab tu phul la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar pam̐ las pad+ma sogs nas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis mdzes pa zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar dang*/

rtsibs bzhi la sogs kyis rgyal chen bzhi bskyed/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs nas rje btsun yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod cing bstims la/ dbang lha spyan drang*/ mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa/ dbang bskur ba rnams 'dra ba la chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ rgyal chen gyi tshab tu sgrol dkar sogs bskyed na'ang rigs bdag spo ba ma gtogs sgrub pa'i dus dang 'dra/ lugs gnyis po gang ltar yang lha thams cad 'dzum zhing tshims pa'i nyams can/ 'od zer ser po spro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi blo dang*/ ye shes dang*/ ngag gi dpal yon gtso bor gyur pa'i srid zhi'i phun tshogs thams cad rgyas pa'i las mdzad par gyur ces dang*/ dgang blugs blangs te lha thams cad kyi zhal sogs nas gsol bar bsams la/ rtsa sngags lan gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ bdun dang mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī prā sogs dang*/ bdag gi blo dang sogs spel tshig sbyar/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon skyems 'bul/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs la mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar bas mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs dang*/ rgyal ba kun gyi sogs dang*/ 'khor rnams la/ zab cing rgya cher gzigs pa po// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ 'khor gyi bskyed chog phyi ma ltar yin na/ mkhyen dang brtse ba'i snang ba dam pa yis// sgrub pa po yi blo mun rab bsal nas// rmad byung phan bde'i dpal la sbyor mdzad pa'i// 'das dang ma 'das 'khor gyi tshogs la 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas khyad par gyi rdzas bcu po rtsa sngags kho nas brgya rtsa brgyad re nges par 'bul zhing*/ sde tshan re re'i mthar spel tshig gong ltar sbyar/ yam shing la sogs pa yod na rtsa sngags lan gsum re sngon du 'gro ba'i rang sngags spel tshig dang bcas pas dbul ba me lha dang 'dra/

slar yang byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar bdun tshan gsum gshegs skyems su phul la/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos nas byin gyis brlabs/ thal mo sbyar te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// zhes sogs tshig bcad gang rigs dang bcas pa'i sngags rgyas dbul/ spro na gos zung dang*/ rin chen bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ 'dod yon lnga rnams spyi ltar dbul/ yig rnying nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa rgyas pas bstod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ thab kyi lha la phul ba'i mthar mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ 'dod pa'i don gsol la/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod gsol dang*/ oṃ khyod kyis sogs dang*/ mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs shing*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la mtheb srin gyis thal ba blangs te dpral bar byug go /slar yang mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg cing blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas rnams lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig re phul ba'i mthar/ byon skyems ltar mar bdun tshan gsum phul/ me lha'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas kyis mchog sbyin dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i mchod pa dang bstod pa gong bzhin byas la/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha/

me lha rang bzhin pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la bsngo smon dang shis brjod rgyas par bya/ me mnal ba dang thal ba chu klung chen por dor te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// dbang gi ril bu sgrub pa dang 'brel na 'di nyid la dbang gi sbyin sreg gzhan nas cung zad bkab pas 'grub bo// gnyis pa bsnyen pa rkyang pa'i kha skong gi tshul ni/ sbyor ba'i skabs su thab kyi thig sogs sngar bzhin la nang du 'khor gyi mtshan ma 'god du med pas 'khor lo rgyas pa nyid bri ba legs te/ de yang rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud cha phran gcig gis bskor ba/ lte bar ral gri'i yu bar dhīḥ rtsibs brgyad la g.yas skor du dbyangs yig gnyis gnyis dang*/ mu khyud la gsal byed rnams g.yas skor du tshon dmar po la sogs pas bri ba ni khyad par ro// rdzas ni khyad par gyi rdzas bcu po kho nas 'thus/ dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed nas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i bar 'dra/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma sogs kyis rje btsun yab yum bdag bskyed ltar bskyed la rigs bdag spo/ 'khor gyi bstod pa dor zhing tshig gi phrad bsgyur dgos pa ni shes sla/ bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ me tog ser po'am ma 'byor na 'bras yung bas kha bsgyur ba la grangs bzung ste rtsa sngags khri phrag bzhi sogs 'gro nges bya/ rjes kyi chos ni 'dra ba nyid do// nyi ma gsum sogs byed na sngar gyi thal ba'i steng du bud shing brtsigs pa tsam gyis don 'grub bo// las phran tshegs gzhan rnams ni yig rnying na gsal bar bzhugs so// de lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag lag len dang bcas pa 'di ni yig rnying sa 'og gi ro langs pa'am/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ grub pa'i zhal lung gi nyin byed yig gsar rgyu skar gyi gzi brjid la gnod kyi dogs nas gling gzhan gyi mkha' dbyings su byol ba/

dad dang brtson pa'i skya rengs kyis mkhas pa'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen du drangs pa'o// 'khyogs bshad mun pa'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i// grub dbang dgongs don nyin byed 'di shar tshe// chos kun bdag gis stong pa'i ye shes dang*// phul byung spobs pa 'dod rnams dbu thegs shig /legs byas rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i sprin rum nas// bde dang phan pa nor bu'i gru char gyis// skye 'gro'i re ba 'gengs shing mkhas tshul gyis// thub bstan skyong ba'i 'byor rnga brdung gyur cig /ces rje btsun smra ba'i seng ge'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag ngag 'dod dang bcas pa rmongs pa'i bdud las rnam rgyal ye shes mchog gi nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di ni rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas 'drir 'os so zhes gzengs bstod kyi dbyangs snyan bsgrags pa la brten nas rgyal khams pa ngag dbang legs grub kyis rgya gzhung sogs yi ge snga phyi rnams la zhib tu dpyad de dpal e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// ༈ /'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal snying po'i dril ba grub pa mchog gi zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na go gu ru wā di siṃ hā ya/ blo ldan gang zhig nges par 'byung ba dang byang chub sems gnyis kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pas myur du thams cad gzigs pa'i ye shes la bsnyen par bya ba'i slad du 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo sgrub par 'dod pas/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba dang gdams ngag legs par nos te dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i bsam gtan gyi khang bur rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// de la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs gtso bor gyur pa'i skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i spyan sngar skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams spyi ltar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge sngon po bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge dhīḥdamar po dang*/ mdun gyi sa gzhir pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyig mthing zhun gyi mdog lta bu/ de gnyis las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal/ tshur 'dus yi ge gnyis la thim pas dhīḥyongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas

yig cha phyi ma rnams su phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyar gsungs kyang rtsa ba'i yig rnying rnams kyi dgongs pa ni 'di kho na ste/ des mtshon gong 'og rnams su yig cha phyi ma dang mi mthun pa rnams yig rnying sor bzhag pa'o// shes rab kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i cha lugs can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bsgrengs pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'bar bas mtshan pa'i lhag ma zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar ral gri sor bzhi pa gyen 'greng du 'khod pa'i changs zung la dhīḥdamar po'i mthar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ mdun gyi hrīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog sngon po cung zad khro zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ ral gri dang pusti 'dzin cing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bus mtshan cing lhag ma lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis sku 'gying bag dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du ral gri sor bzhi pa'i changs zung la hrīḥyig sngon po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par bsams la/ lhar snang sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du sems 'dzin/

des skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad 'jam dpal yab yum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar yang thugs ka'i dhīḥlas dhīḥyig gi phreng ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ rang gi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ yum gyi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de las grol ba'i tshul gyis hrīḥyig gi phreng ba sna bug g.yas nas byung*/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs pas ā li kā li'i sngags su gyur te lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad kyang sngags kyi yi ges gtams pas blo yi mun pa thams cad bsal nas/ shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas/ de ltar sngags phreng rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba'i bar nas shes rab kyi bung ba'i tshogs 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med par phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang bla ma dam pa rnams kyi byin rlabs/ nyan rang gi shes rab/ so so skye bo'i nus mthu rnams bsdus nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus ye shes dang ldan par byas/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas bka' sde snod gsum gyi bcud/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i shes rab/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi nus pa/ sman gyi nus pa rnams bsdus nas rang gi lce la thim pas ngag nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas rtsi shing nags tshal gyi bcud/ nyi zla'i 'od zer/ rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu rin po che'i 'od/ lha klu gza' skar rnams kyi shes rab dang nus pa/ rgyal po dang btsun mo'i sems rnams bsdus te rang gi thugs kar thim pas thugs bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang ldan par gyur/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa dang ma bral ba'i ngang*/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me dī paṃ mañju shrī mum̐ hrīḥpra dz+nyā war+dhā ni hrīḥdhīḥswā hā/

zhes ji tsam nus pa bzlas pa'i mthar dbyangs gsal dang rten 'brel snying por sngags kyi nus pa brtan par bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal nas bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim/ de ral gri la thim/ de dhīḥl thim/ de thig le dmar por gyur pa 'od du zhu nas snang ba thams cad dmar lam gyis song bas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad dbang du byas par bsams la/ 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang du blo bzhag de las ldang ba na/ slar yang rang skad cig gis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi skur gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam dpal yab yum 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug thun mtshams su ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pas 'bul zhing mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ nyal ba'i tshe 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang du nyal/ ldang ba na nam mkha' stong pa las dbyangs can ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas dhīḥhrīḥ'i sngags kyi bskul bar bsams la sgyu ma lta bu'i lha'i skur ldang*/ bsnyen pa byed na gtsang sbra dang bcas thun gsum mam bzhi'i rim pas sngags 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa'am/ gzhung nas bshad pa'i rtags rnams dngos sam rmi lam du mthong ba'i bar bzla/ de nas kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang*/ bogs 'byin pa'i slad du ril bu sgrub pa dang*/ las kyi tshogs rab 'byams kyis rang gzhan la phan gdags pa rnams ni rtsa ba'i yig rnying gsal byed dang bcas pa rnams las rtogs par bya ba kho na'o// tshul de ltar 'bad pas gnas skabs su shes rab phyogs med du skye zhing mngon par shes pa dang*/
